description: You will not be far from the comfort of your home during your stay in this large one-bedroom apartment with an additional seating area, an integrated kitchenette, and a spacious bathroom , which is located on the main street in the center of the famous Sisli area. In this apartment located in our hotel, we have a reception 7/24 , the entire hotel is monitored by a camera security system that operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. We also have a big elevator in the hotel.

reviews.text:
Absolutely loved my stay at this cozy flat in Şişli! The apartment was spotless, modern, and exactly as pictured. The interior design is sleek yet homey, and the huge, comfy sofa was perfect for relaxing after long days out in Istanbul.
Check-in was a breeze thanks to Erkan, who was super responsive and kind from start to finish. He made sure everything went smoothly.
The location is perfect — central enough to easily access the metro, shopping centers, and restaurants, but also quiet enough for a good night’s sleep. Plus, having free street parking and a washer was a total bonus!
If you’re looking for a stylish and hassle-free place to stay in Istanbul, I 100% recommend this flat. Will definite
It was a great experience the hotel super clean the room as the photos exactly and the stuff so friendly and helpful.feel like home I highly recommend it

Çalışanlar çok güleryüzlüydü. Bizi çok güzel karşıladılar. Çok ilgililerdi. Kendimizi güvende hissettik. Kolay bulunabilir konumu vardı. Çevresinde her türlü mağaza ve işletme mevcut. Sessizdi. Kendi evimiz gibiydi. Oda çok temizdi. Her şey fotoğraftaki gibiydi. Banyo tertemizdi. Tüm olanaklar vardı. Herkese tavsiye ediyoruz. Çok teşekkür ederiz.
Konum olarak istanbulun göbeğinde. Personel gayet ilgiliydi. Temizlik ve konfor bakımından 5 puanı hakeden bir işletme. Rahat bir şekilde tercih edebilirsiniz
Great stay overall. The location is very convenient and made it easy to get around. The host was extremely friendly, helpful, and responsive throughout the stay.

description: Our place, which is close to Taksim Square, will provide a suitable and comfortable accommodation for our guests. This apartment is located on the 1st floor and the apartment can be accessed by stairs. The apartment has a portable kitchen where you can make simple meals. You can also spend time in our backyard as a common area and create a working environment for yourself while drinking your hot drinks.

reviews.text:
Great location. Close to Taksim square, just a few minute walk to metro station and bus stop as well. Lots of supermarkets, grocery shops are around. A few minute walk to both Taksim metro station and bus stop. Mr Serhat is very responsive to any requests even if it is late at night. He is friendly and helpful. He helped us with our suitcases up the stairs. He also provided us with a small gas stove. Moreover, he gave us his own metro card to use during the Eid Holiday since all transportations are free of charge during this occasion. He is really a super host.
The studio is as described. Photos reflect reality. Just two drawbacks; the first is the terrible smell of sewage in the toilet and the second one is that the building is situated on a slope.

Serhat was truly the best host I could’ve asked for. He was incredibly patient, always quick to respond, and went out of his way to be helpful and respectful. From the moment I arrived, he made everything smooth with clear directions and a kind attitude.
The room was clean and cozy — a bit small, but it had everything I needed. The real highlight, though, was the lovely garden downstairs! It was such a peaceful spot to enjoy my breakfast, and I took plenty of beautiful photos there.
For the price, the place was absolutely worth it, and Serhat’s warm-hearted nature made the experience even better. I highly recommend staying here — you’ll be in great hands!

Serhan’s place was a great deal, it was clean and extremely close to Taksim. Like other reviews mentioned the only issue we had was the smell from the bathroom, initially it was my that bad but by the second day it got stronger. It might be useful to have an air freshener or something. It was a small place but exactly what we needed and it was clean. There is a hill but not as bad as other ones in Istanbul but just be aware, it’s on the first floor (starts at 0 in Turkey) with no elevator which means stairs. He gave us tea, coffee, and toilet paper which is a rarity in Turkey. The best part was how responsive the host was with recommendations, luggage hold after check out, and overall quick to reply to anything we needed! There was also someone named Sarah who was great, she introduced herself to us and invited us for tea, provided recommendations for places to eat and other services. The hosts were generally was so nice and great! Definitely recommend for the price!

The location is excellent. Taksim is 5 minutes away. 1 minute away great places to eat. It was clean and the host absolutely helpful and friendly. Only 2 problems were the curtains that somehow didn’t cover the whole window making us feel exposed and the old furniture which doesn’t look like it in the photos. Overall though it was absolutely great.

I recently had the pleasure of staying at Sarhat Apartment, and I can’t recommend it highly enough! The host was incredibly helpful and polite, always available for any questions or assistance we needed.
The apartment is conveniently located just a short walk from Taksim and all forms of public transport, making it easy to explore the city. One of the highlights of our stay was the host allowing us to drop off our luggage five hours before check-in, which made our arrival so much smoother.
The apartment itself was very clean and well-maintained, providing a comfortable and welcoming atmosphere. Overall, this was a fantastic experience, and I would definitely stay here again. Thank you for a wonderful stay!

description:
Merhaba! This Apartment is Long Term Rental!
Diamond is very cosy and comfortable apartment with all the conveniences you could hope for. Location is ideal, an easy walk into Beyoglu with all its bars and restaurants.Fantastic Golden Horn view awaits you.Magnificent Suleymaniye Mosque is so nice through your window.

reviews.text:
Deniz Apartments (Diamond) was overall phenomenal. To begin with, the host (Hatice), went out of her way to accommodate our early arrival/late departure. Not only was she there to welcome us in our "home in Istanbul", but she also remained in communication with me prior to our arrival at the airport to make sure all was going as planned and, once we landed, she coordinated our drive from the airport with our taxi driver. For this alone, the rating is worth the 5 stars above.
When it comes to the apartments, they accommodated all of us (four adults) very comfortably. All of the amenities listed online were as described, and there were even some nice extras (Laundry detergent, basic food items like tea and coffee, drying racks, books, board games, movies, etc).
Another plus was the fact that the place is located in a residential area of Beyoglu, which makes it very quiet at night in comparison with many other areas - we enjoyed full nights of sleep virtually undisturbed. (The comfort of the beds might have played a role in it as well...)
Although it may seem far from the old quarters (and most of hte toruists venues) on the map, we were surprised to realize how easy it was to go from there to the old city. With close access to the funicular (known as Tunel in Turkish as we found out the second day looking for it) and the tram makes for a very easy and scenic transfer to and from at virtually any time of the day/evening. We even skipped all this the first and simply walked to the he old quarters, which turned out to be, roughly, a 20 mins walk. The advantage of staying in Beyoglu however, was that it allowed us to enjoyed the old town by day and the quite vibrant night life (restaurants, bars, and stores) that the famous Independence Avenue has to offer by night while being close to "home" when we finally wanted our rest. In the end, we were actually glad we had chosen to stay in Beyoglu instead of the old town. After a hectic day in the over crowded tourist central of the old town, it was a nice change to wander the streets of the new, which offers a more local tone. Deniz apartments were a mere 5 mins wander down a street near the start of Independence Avenue. The other advantage of being off the tourist strip was that you will enjoy "local" prices for food and other items as opposed to the ridiculously inflated "tourist" prices of other location. On this, there are 2 local stores where you can find food within a block from Deniz Apartments, another bonus.
To sum it up, this apartment was extremely clean, location (for us) was ideal, it was in a quiet area, and the host was phenomenal. I highly recommend this place as it is well worth the price.

We were travelling as a family, mother and 2 adult children, and we loved this apartment. Hatice gave us a warm welcome at the apartment, helping us with a few specific queries and providing a general overview of the surrounds. We stayed for 6 nights and appreciated the thoughtful small additions that made us feel welcome guests.
The apartment is extremely comfortable and well designed, making the most of the space. We loved the view of the water and being able to regulate the temperature and open the windows.
The apartment is fabulously well situated, a short walk to the more traditional neighbourhood where inexpensive local food was available and an equally short walk to fashionable Pera. For longer distances we found the ferry, buses and taxis all easy and accessible.
Despite its proximity to almost everything, it was blissfully quiet at night. We'll be back.
Thank-you so much.

There is an abundance of reviews about Hatice's properties and I'm happy to add my voice to the choir of positive feedback. We stayed on the second floor of the building and so had few stairs but not the kinds of views you can get from higher up (we saw the inside of the top floor flat and the view was phenomenal). Still, the flat was impeccably clean, very comfortable, and quite spacious for two people. In addition, as mentioned, Hatice checks in to make sure everything is OK, and responds to messages quickly even though she is a busy woman.

The location of the building is just a short walk to the main action of Beyoglu and has the advantage of being in a quiet and basically non-touristic neighborhood, complete with communal cats (and one very friendly dog). Special shout-out to the cleaning lady (I'm afraid we didn't catch her name). Though she doesn't speak any English and neither of us speak any Turkish, we had many warm exchanges with her- she made us tea when we arrived, greeted us when we passed her on the street, and helped us out when we stupidly locked ourselves out of the building (Hatice too was great in this situation).

I have absolutely no reservations in recommending this airbnb and Hatice as a host.

Hatice is an amazing host! We were in Istanbul for 5 days for my boyfriends 30th birthday. We were 4 people, us and his 2 brothers, and the apartment was perfect! The location is amazing and within walking distance to everything! (as long as you like walking, maybe, but we walked over the bridge everyday to the other side to see things). The view from the living room is definitely amazing and we spent more nights in the living room playing cards than searching for a better view. The apartment was very clean and was exactly as described. On the last day, she helped us store our luggage away since our flight wasn't until 21:00. Overall, it was a great trip and staying with Hatice as a host was even more lovely - she definitely was a defining point of the trip with her hospitality, kindness, and information.

I felt like a local in the city of Istanbul at Hatice's place and it was wonderful. An apartment building with a view over the water and Golden Horn and the view out of the living room window(s) was just tremendous.
The place is a lot bigger than the photos make it out to be and Hatice was a terrific host who was responsive and helpful along the way!
It's close to the subway station making it easy to get to/from the airport.
I would not hesitate to stay here again!

description: Bright 3-bedroom apartment in the heart of Moda, one of Istanbul’s most vibrant neighborhoods. Just a 10-minute walk from Kadıköy Ferry Port and 15 minutes from the Moda park. Surrounded by cafés, restaurants, and boutique shops, it’s the perfect base to enjoy the city’s creative energy and lively street life.

reviews.text:
The place is much smaller than it appears on the photos. Specifically the leaving room is very narrow and is combined with kitchen while at the same time serving as a corridor for all rooms including bathroom.
The place needs total renovation: all walls were dirty with stains, bathroom had BLACK mold on the ceiling and on the tiles on the walls, here and there floors were crooked and cracked.
A lot of amenities didn’t work or were half broken: the vacuum cleaner stunk, there were broken drawers in the kitchen, some lights did not work, one room had no sockets, drying rack was broken, one fan was broken while the other one was half broken.
The place is on the 3d floor and the stairs are very steep (no elevator) and occasionally very dark because lights on the second floor occasionally do not work.
I need to say that it appears that there was cleaning before check in and all bedsheets and towels were clean.

Awesome location -- in the middle of restaurants and energy. It's now perhaps my favorite neighborhood in Kadikoy. A couple tips: when you hunt for the key box look toward your FEET. And on hotter days this place -- as listed -- does not have air conditioning. We made do and really enjoyed this cozy, clean space. Btw Demir provided great communication before, during and after our stay.

We honestly don’t even know where to start — this place was absolutely amazing. If it were possible, we would rate it 6 out of 5 ⭐️
The flat was perfect in every way. It was very clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed, even the smallest details like plugs and little things that many places usually forget. You can really tell that a lot of care and attention was put into this home.
The location in Kadıköy is great, and the whole experience was made even better by the host. He was extremely kind, helpful, and respectful. He adjusted the check-in time to be earlier for us and allowed a later check-out, which made our trip so much easier and more comfortable. His communication and attitude towards guests were excellent.
We truly couldn’t find a single mistake in the flat. We really loved our stay, enjoyed every moment, and felt completely at home.
Without any doubt, when we come back to Istanbul, we will rent the same place again. Highly recommended to everyone — thank you so

We had a great stay at Hanemo’s place ( and adults and 2 children). Felt like home, spotless, comfy beds, everything you need in the kitchen. We were able to check in early and this was amazing, great communication during our stay. The location is in the heart of Kadikoy, next to the restaurants and shops, it can be a bit nosy in the evening but this is something you can expect considering the location and it didn’t bother us at all and the kids loved it. If I come back I will definitely book again with Hanemo. Thank you for everything.

We had a great stay at Demir’s place. In the middle of the center of Moda, close to the ferry metro and shops/bars/restaurants. The appartment is spacious (we stayed with 2 persons and a baby) and clean. We felt at home. We were a little scared there would be lots of noise of the bars downstairs but it did not bother us at all, we did almost not hear anything.

description:
It is at a vibrant neighborhood nestled in the heart of Istanbul. Here are some fantastic attractions and must-visit spots within walking distance or a short commute from your Airbnb:

1. Hagia Sophia (Ayasofya)

2. Sultanahmet Square:(Blue Mosque, Basilica Cistern)

3. Topkapi Palace

4. Grand Bazaar (Kapalı Çarşı)

5. Spice Bazaar (Mısır Çarşısı)
Seaside is also at walking distance, it is a good spot to RUN or walking.

reviews.text:
Everything was perfect. Impeccable clean place, the host answered fast to messages and I cannot stress enough how spot on the room was when compared to the photos. Sometimes for other listings, the photos look nice, but when you reach the place, you start noticing corners with mould or signs of old age on the shower head, drain, furniture. But here it was not the case! Everything was so nice and shiny, air conditioning worked perfectly and there are so many cosy ambient lights you can chose from to set whatever mood you want for the rooms. The bed's mattress is comfortable and so are the pillows. The towels feel good on the skin, not like cheap plastic. There is really nothing I can complain about. I also like the small balcony because it had a view of the sea; so charming!
The location is also amazing. You are close to the most important landmarks and have a lot of choices when it comes to eating out.
I want to visit Istanbul again and I will definitely come stay at Murat's again.

Quiet location in walking distance to all major sights (10-20 minutes). Tram is 7 minutes walking, boats 20 minutes. The hotel-like room was as described. Murat gave a helpful choice of transport options from the airport from cheap to comfortable. He organised the taxi for me and a member of the family waited for me at check in.
Highly recommend for a sightseeing trip to Istanbul!

Loved this Airbnb from Murat! It gave you a real Turkish vibe and was very clean and centrally located. Plus, you can’t beat the price!
It was located near a handful of strips of restaurants and bars, along with markets as well for anything you needed.
Very clean, very cozy and very comfortable. Also had a small balcony to get some air and see some of the scenery.
Murat was great as well. Very friendly and very responsive. I got in kind of late so it was dark and I had a little bit of trouble finding it because of that but he stayed on the line with me the whole time to make sure I was taken care of.
IF I had to give one downside of this place it’s that you can sometimes hear the other individuals staying there. It was not enough to keep me up at night at all, but something worth nothing. Very very small issue. Everything else was perfect.
Thanks so much Murat!

We have a very nice stay at Murats place. The location was amazing, lots of restaurants nearby and less than a 10min walk to the blue mosque and plenty of other sites. The place was clean, comfortable and the air conditioning was perfect for the heat. The host was also communicative and friendly. Would definitely recommend.

Really good experience staying at Murat’s hotel. It’s a great location with restaurants all around. Be aware of the steep climbs but - then again - where in Istanbul doesn’t have a steep climb?
Murat was responsive and helpful, arranging a taxi with a driver I could write a whole separate review about. Everyone working with Murat was polite, kind, thoughtful, knowledgeable about the area, and considerate. Great value for money, spacious room, close proximity to the public transport, or walking distance to Sultanahmet park.
We felt very comfortable here and would definitely stay again.

description:
Newly renovated, art-inspired cozy place with a panoramic sea view in Pera/Beyoğlu at the heart of Istanbul.

10 mins walk to Istiklal, Galata Tower.
20 mins walk to Karaköy, Galataport.
5-6 mins walk to Şişhane metro line.

Wi-Fi Connection
Workspace
Kitchen
Towels and bathroom amenities incl.
Daily room-keeping is available at an extra charge

The apartment is located on the building's 3rd floor (top floor), with no elevator.

Touristic Rental Residence Permit Nr: 34-1276

reviews.text: Stefan's place is a perfect spot to discover Istanbul. Istiklal street is in nearby (please note, you should go there uphill). Kasimpasa ferry station is 7 min walk from the appartment, there you can cath a ferry to Asian part of Istambul (the most beautiful type of public transportation in the city), nearby there are bus and metro station. Appartment looks exactly how on pictures, has all you need. Balcony view - just spectacular. Internet connection is stable and fast. Please notice, appartment is on the third floor, no elevator, only quite steep stairs - very atmospheric. Stefan is very responsive and he authentecly carres about guests. Summing up, we had a great time at Stefan's appartment, I can highly recommend this place.

The apartment fully matches the photos — everything is exactly as expected, if not even better. The location is perfect: within walking distance of Istiklal Street and the Galata Tower, making it very easy and enjoyable to explore the city.
A special thanks to the host — Stefan was incredibly attentive and caring. We stayed on May 1st, when there were traffic restrictions in the city, and he заранее sent us detailed information about road closures, which made everything much easier to navigate.
The view from the balcony is something truly special. A stunning panorama, especially at sunset — one of those moments that makes you want to come back again.
Our stay exceeded all expectations. Even going up the stairs with our two-year-old was not a problem at all — she actually enjoyed it 😊
Thank you so much for the warm welcome, genuine hospitality, and the opportunity to experience life in one of the most beautiful cities!

Stefan’s place was simply amazing provided so comfortable and exciting stay in Istanbul! It was so clean and quiet with a stunning view from a bed over the balcony.
Host is always nicely kind, responsive, flexible and very keen to support. Surrounding is also super convenient. Short walk to bus stops where bus for many routes and destinations comes very often, to nice bars and restaurants and shopping. My recommendation for bars and restaurants is Asmalı Mescit Cd, which you can reach just with crossing one big road. The street continues as Kumbaracı Ykş, which is filled with unique shops that I found best for those who is looking for local designers and artisans.
Only one small negative is stairs. It is not a daily problem but maybe when you have a big luggage. But it is not unsolvable as I managed.
Super recommendable place to stay.
I’ll definitely stay again when return to the city!!

We really enjoyed the apartment. It is located in a pleasant, peaceful, fun area that is walkable to a lot of interesting places. The apartment itself is very charming, clean, and well-thought out. It has everything we needed in the kitchen, and was very comfortable. The stairs up to it kept us in shape after eating too much doner and baklava!

Absolutely lovely apartment in an ideal location in the city center. Everyone in the house and the surrounding area is very friendly. The apartment is very clean, the bed linen always smells of washing. The balcony has a beautiful view of the river. We are demanding about cleanliness and Stefan's apartment is one of the few that really meets the cleanliness requirements. I just want to point out that if the temperature outside is above 36 degrees Celsius, the apartment does not have air conditioning. The stairs to the 3rd floor are fine. I carried the suitcases one by one myself and it was possible :-) Older people might not have to give it a try. Overall, a beautiful apartment on a high floor!!!

description:
Experience a journey of great hospitality at our 2023 restored finely furbished home comfort, hotel standard serviced apartments with 24 hour reception and housekeeping, Nestled in the heart of Istanbul, you will be a mere 10 minutes away from Galataport, Galata, Taksim, and Bosphorus by walk. The tram to Sultanahmet and Balat is conveniently within reach.
Staying at Cihangir, a safe residential cosy district, you will enjoy many famous local cafes, restaurants, and Çukurcuma antique shops.

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb in Istanbul. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described in the listing. The location was excellent, with easy access to public transport, restaurants, cafés, and many of Istanbul's famous attractions.
The host was exceptionally helpful and responsive, providing clear instructions and great local recommendations. The apartment was well-equipped, making our stay convenient and enjoyable.
One of the highlights was experiencing the charm of Istanbul while staying in a neighborhood that felt authentic and welcoming. We would gladly stay here again and highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting Istanbul.

This was a great place to stay during our time in Istanbul and a very well-appointed apartment and kitchen that made it easy to cook and eat without going out. The room is spacious and comfortable. The street is very quiet, though we did hear some people walking above us the final two nights, so that may be an issue for some other light sleepers. Check-in and out was very easy as there is always someone at the front desk to assist with any questions. Very walkable to great restaurants nearby.

The apartment was clean and super comfortable. Reception staff are friendly and very helpful. We enjoyed spending some evenings on the rooftop which has fabulous views, this apartment is in a great location.

The apartment is in a very central location in Cihangir and it is very well maintained. The furniture, bathroom, and kitchen all feel quite new and everything is very comfortable to use. I was very satisfied with my long stay. As someone who lived in Cihangir for many years in the past, I truly felt right at home here. Also the lobby staff were also very helpful whenever I needed assistance. This was not my first stay here and it certainly won’t be my last. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone planning to stay in Istanbul.

One of the best Airbnb experiences I’ve ever had
Had no particular expectations going in – and ended up completely blown away. The place turned out to be a proper apart-hotel: spacious, light-filled apartments with beautiful floors and everything you could possibly need, all thought through down to the last detail.
But what really made this stay special is the location. This is, without a doubt, one of Istanbul’s finest neighborhoods – the kind of place that has its own unmistakable character and charm, where you genuinely don’t want to leave. And yet, when you do need to get somewhere, the city couldn’t be more accessible: tram, metro, and ferries are all within easy reach, making navigation a breeze whether you’re heading across town or across the Bosphorus.
Highly recommend to anyone looking for a comfortable, well-equipped base in the heart of the best Istanbul has to offer.

description:
A magnificent house with 5 air-conditioned rooms with different designs, a large flowered garden and a balcony, where you can have a peaceful holiday with your family and loved ones

There are 2 separate toilets in the apartment, a bathroom with jacuzzi and a bathroom with Turkish bath.
You can have a pleasant holiday where you will feel at home in a detached mansion that belongs only to you.

reviews.text:
Unfortunately staying at this location was one of the worst experiences we've had.
Good things:
-location is very close to main attractions like Hagia Sofia and Blue Mosque
-Rooftop is just as beautiful as the photos describe and have great views
-hosts/managers responsive
Bad things:
-the "villa" is much smaller than the photos seem to show
-there were bugs in one of the rooms and there was a lot of dust
-it was very noisy and the windows/doors didn't block out much noise
-some of the bedroom and bathroom doors didn't close properly until being slammed shut
-one of the hosts entered the house twice without consent or advanced warning
More on the unsolicited entries: twice the property manager entered the house with their own key without asking us ahead of time if we were home (we had been in touch the whole stay). this made is feel very uncomfortable, especially at night or when any of the group was alone at the house. overall big safety concerns with this host.

The apartment looks a lot better in photos than in real life. There are in fact two apartments in one, the 1st floor has Two bedrooms, a a half bath and another room with a showerhead that I guess would be considered a bath however it is extremely uncomfortable to shower and and the water doesn’t drain. The second floor, which is accessible through another lock door has another bedroom and the living room. We complained after the first night and the host was very responsive and they moved us to another one of their apartments which was actually much better and nicer, but we also lost power for a good part of the day in that apartment. The host was very concerned about us giving them a five star review and brought a number of sweets for me and made sure that he was there early in the morning to pick up our luggage and help us get it in the car that was very responsive. However, it was to ensure that we gave him a five star review. He actually asked for that several times.

Had a lovely stay. Hamza was super friendly and helpful. Bedrooms great. Nice tub upstairs. It was very cold (February) so we hardly used the terrace but that would be lovely in better weather.
We did find the kitchen really small. Even just for eating breakfast and making tea. No counter space, nowhere even to wash tea cups. So do consider that.
Overall, great place. Just like the photos with a very helpful responsive host.

Let’s start with the location: you can’t beat it if you want to see the tourist attraction in the Fatih area. You are literally 3 mins walk from the Blue Mosque, which is a gorgeous experience once the sun goes down and the tourists go away. If you have young kids, you can step out for a walk late at night.
Then the terrace: what a balcony + view. We spent every evening on it till late. You have the view of the sea on one side and the blue mosque on the other. Pictures actually don’t do it justice.
Lastly (and at times most importantly), the team: they are all super helpful on a joint chat. We had issue one evening with one of the room’s AC not working. It was close to mid night. Now there are enough ACs in the house that if you leave the doors open, they take care of the weak link. However, Ismael was over to look into it in a few mins. It’s great to not feel stranded in those situation, which can happen every once in a while in any such location.
Highly recommend!!

The Airbnb was close to many historic sites and the Grand Bazaar. Walkable to many restaurants and cafes.
The place was a bit outdated. Also instead of being one place it was more like two separate apartments connected by hallway stairs. 1 bedroom and living space upstairs and 3 other bedrooms in a separate apartment.
The host was responsive and arranged airport transfers for us.

description:
Located where Istanbul's heart beats!!! 5 mins walk from the famous Taksim Square, just a minute away from THE Istiklal Street and 10 minutes tram ride from the historical peninsula.

Start the day in the marbled and tiled bathroom, followed by breakfast at the glass-topped dining table. Corniced ceilings are above, polished wood floors below, and in-between is a plethora of eclectic art, from landscapes to Modigliani prints.

reviews.text:
We had a warm & cozy 4 night stay at Dilek's 1-bed apartment, which is a few mins walk from the famous Istiklal street. Photos and description of the place are accurate and communication with Dilek was seamless. Dilek is a very warm & welcoming host and is fluent in English. She replied to our messages promptly and the check-in & check-out experience was smooth. We communicated via Whatsapp.
There are three nearby options for public transport - Tram(T1 line): Tophane Station; Tunel funicular station and Sishane Metro station.
The taxi ride from Ataturk airport is around 70 Lira. There are numerous cafes, eateries, book stores within walking distance. There's a nearby grocery/convenience store for all your needs.
Note: Our apartment was on the first floor, and be extra careful on that spiral staircase. Another point to note is the view from the bedroom is blocked and we didn't' get as much sunlight as we hoped. There's ample sunlight in other rooms.
You won't go wrong with this cozy, well decorated apartment in a great location!!

I had a wonderful stay at this flat. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described in the listing. The location was convenient, with easy access to public transport, shops, restaurants and tourist spots. The host was very responsive and helpful, making the check-in and check-out process smooth. Overall, a great experience. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul and would be happy to stay here again

We found Dilek's place to be perfect for our stay in Istanbul. The apartment is exactly as shown in the pictures and is right in the middle of the old town of Beyoglu.
The apartment is on the second floor, was very clean and has wide windows which can be opened on either side to let the breeze in during the hot Istanbul summers. The location is great for those looking to eat out and use public transport to see the sights of Istanbul. Istiklal street is around 10 minutes walking from the apartment from which there are hundreds of places to shop and eat. The place is also 15 minutes walking from 3 metro stops, sishane, taksim and the tophane tram stop. From there, any of the top attractions of Istanbul can be reached very cheaply.

Dilek's apartment is exactly as described. We had very easy check in and check out.
The location is perfect. Very near to everywhere. including public transportation. There is a taxi stop in front of the house. Walking distance to istiklal and kabatas. also metro station
Dilek is a perfect host and she replies our queries very promptly.
The cleaniss of the house was perfect. We had nice time. definetely visit dilek's house again.

We stayed at Dilek's place for a week and it was just wonderful. The flat is just as seen on the pictures. It is clean, comfortable and located in the heart of Beyoglu.
Dilek was a very nice host. After booking she immediately confirmed it and made sure we know exactly where the location of the flat is. Communication with her during our stay was also very easy and quick.

description:
Nestled in the heart of vibrant Karakoy, newly renovated studio units offer the perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience for your stay in Istanbul.

Step outside and find yourself immersed in the vibrant energy of Karakoy. Indulge in a variety of cafes, restaurants, and shops just steps away from your door. Galataport is within 5 min walking distance.

Allowing you to easily explore Istanbul's rich history and vibrant culture.

Passport/ID info to the host during check-in bylaw

reviews.text:
Had a great stay in this appartment over a weekend! Nice, modern and clean. Everything as described and as in pictures. Easy communication with hosts and check-in.
Very good location for exploring Istanbul. As it is so central it will also be a bit noisy from the traffic outside, but that is as expected. Value for money - would reccomend :)

We had an amazing stay at this Airbnb! The location is fantastic, conveniently situated in a great area, making it easy to explore the surroundings. The room itself was exactly as described in the listing, spacious, clean, and thoughtfully designed for comfort.
The host was friendly and helpful, always responsive and willing to offer recommendations or assistance whenever needed. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable and well-located stay. I would definitely book again in the future!

Fantastic, I loved it!
I stayed in this incredible place for 18 nights. I initially booked for just 3 nights, but I felt so comfortable and happy that I decided to extend my stay for the rest of my trip. I absolutely recommend it 100%!
The location is unbeatable: just steps away from Galataport, with immediate access to public transportation, grocery stores, and surrounded by the most charming restaurants in Karaköy.
The studio is spacious, bright, modern, and very well designed. Ekin was always very responsive, attentive, and helpful. The cleaning lady was also lovely and kind.
I especially recommend this place to people with limited mobility or anyone who finds it difficult to walk up steep hills — this location is perfect in that regard. The building is easily accessible, and it’s an ideal base to explore this vibrant city.
I’ll be coming back next year for a longer stay! Thank you so much for everything!

My husband and I stayed here for 5 days, and I must say this place truly made our first visit to Istanbul more enjoyable and hassle-free. On our first night, we simply walked around to explore and ended up at Galataport, taking a walk by the Bosphorus. The apartment itself exceeded our expectations — the photos don’t do it justice! From the balcony, you get a side-sea view to the left and a stunning view of Galata Tower to the right.
The location is perfect. It’s close to all the transportation — ferry, tram, and bus — and is also within walking distance of many great restaurants and areas, which makes getting around the city incredibly easy. Our host was very responsive and helpful throughout our stay, making everything smooth and comfortable.
Overall, it was a wonderful experience and it felt like a perfect home base in Istanbul. I would definitely recommend this stay to anyone visiting the city and looking for both comfort and convenience.

Cozy and clean apartment on 2nd floor with a mini balcony. bed was comfortable and clean. Furniture was very clean and firm. Bathroom was clean. Kitchen was in good condition. There was a electric water boiler which was good but needs coffee/ tea mugs/ glasses. There was only tall glasses for juice and if I put hot water in the glasses I was scared they would shatter or break. Drinking morning tea was difficult. No stove but there was a microwave. The apartment is located on a busy taxi corner so getting a taxi was very easy. The late nights with car horns was not bad, I had no problem sleeping. Really close to the bridge to walk across to the Grand bazzare, Sofia Hagia, or Blue Mosque.
Blow dryer, washer and dryer (floor 4.5) was available also.
I had a beautiful time. this apartment was close to the out side mall and Cruise ship ports where you can walk and see the Bosphorus River in 3 min. This area had a lot of restaurants that you can walk 2 min and eat.
Overall very nice.

description:
Experience the perfect blend of comfort and convenience in our exceptional apartment, ideal for families and travelers.
​The Space
Relax in a bright, stylish unit with high-speed Wi-Fi and access to our stunning seasonal outdoor pool. Enjoy the ultimate convenience with an on-site supermarket, hair salon, restaurant, and a fun children’s play area right at your doorstep!
​Note: Access to the building's gym, spa, Turkish bath, and indoor pool is not included, reflected in our great rate.

reviews.text:
Stunning views and a comfortable stay! The hosts are very accommodating of all the requests and responsive. Having a supermarket downstairs is very handy.
Being a solo traveller I felt very safe here! Thank you Home Hotel for making my trip a memorable one.

Konumu çok iyiydi fakat temizlik ve 3. Kişinin yatacağı yatak malzemelerini söylediğim halde getirmemeleri gece koltukta yatan arkadaşımızın tekrar istememize rağmen getirilmeyen yastık battaniye ve yatak örtüsü yüzünden memnun kalmadık bir daha tercih etmeyeceğiz.

I splurged a little and it was definitely worth it! very friendly staff, easy to find, convenient shops downstairs. host was very kind and responsive and very good at answering all questions and meeting all our needs during our stay.I have no complaints. will definitely recommend!

This place has stunning views is a very nice apartment beautifully furnished and modern with all the amenities. Beautiful building with supermarket downstairs and everything you would need. Stunning views of Istanbul and the host was exceptional very friendly and always available.

An exceptional apartment nestled in an ideal location, complemented by the exceptional hospitality of its host. Boasting the most panoramic view of the city, the apartment situated on the 37th floor offers an unparalleled vantage point that encompasses a significant portion of the urban landscape of Istanbul.

description: This spacious 2 BR apartment in Beyoğlu, Cihangir features 100 m² of modern living space and a unique backyard. Enjoy barbecues with friends, and delightful dinners at our 3-meter solid wood table. For children, there’s a large toy cabinet. A high chair and baby bed are available. Have fun at the pub next door. Hold meetings with our projector. The apartment includes a rustic bathroom, large work desk, and 60-inch TV. Just a 3-minute walk to the tram, making city exploration easy.

reviews.text:
We had an enjoyable 17-night stay in Istanbul. The apartment was spacious, clean, and well-located.
However, the apartment felt jaded and didn’t live up to the photos. The large TV pictured was broken and left against a wall, several light bulbs were missing, there were no fans in the bedrooms (as promised), and basic kitchen items were lacking — though the host did address these issues upon request. We arrived late at night and were very disappointed to find no basic provisions of water, toilet paper, or detergent - requiring a late trip out.
The garden space, a key reason for booking, was uninviting - it hadn’t been cleaned or set up as pictured, so we didn’t use it. The glass doors were broken with no locks, so we had to keep the shutters closed for security. There were also intermittent WiFi issues and occasional water outages.
Given the high price, we felt the standard and overall experience sadly didn’t live up to what was advertised.

We had a great stay at Musa's. Serhad was super helpful and responsive. The location is perfect because it's away from the noise but still near the main attractions. The house is on a nice street with lots of restaurants. The house itself was clean and has all the amenities. Would definitely recommend!

Our host, Serhad, was very friendly and responsive and accommodated our changing plans. We loved the location, lots to see and do locally with easy access by trams, the metro and ferries. We enjoyed the apartment's space and size with its large, comfortable beds, great dining table, large courtyard and comfortable couch. There was construction happening next door, and outside but this didn't bother us too much and all was quiet after about 5pm. The apartment isn't 5-star luxury and glamour and it doesn't claim to be. Overall, we had a comfortable stay and loved Istanbul!

The apartment is spacious, comfortable, safe. There is an open courtyard with soft furniture for drinking tea or coffee. Kind and affable hosts. They helped with everything, including making sure that we do not overpay for a taxi. Musa and Serhad were always available, quickly responded to requests, gave excellent advice

it was very comfortable stay very homely feel and responsive host... hope to stay again in this beautiful place ...living room is awesome
host is an architect and very friendly

description: Enjoy easy access to popular shops and restaurants from this charming place to stay.

reviews.text: We were very comfortable in this charming small hotel .Great location, close to the Metro that goes to Sabiha Gokcen airport and the ferry terminal to the Princes Islands and the European side. Lots of restaurants and cafes within a few hundred meters. We were on the second floor and therefore not affected by the floors creaking. However the stairs are steep. Kind host Incredibly good value. Next time we come to Kadikoy we will stay again

I had a very pleasant stay here. The room was spacious, bright, and clean — just like in the photos. The location is excellent: quiet street but just a few minutes’ walk from the Kadıköy pier, restaurants, and shops. It’s easy to get around both the Asian and European sides from here.
Communication with the host was smooth, and check-in went without any issues. Perfect spot for a short stay in Istanbul if you want to explore the local side of the city away from the tourist crowds.

We really enjoyed our stay here. Some of the comments in previous reviews regarding the neighborhood noise may have some truth to them, but in our experience, what you'll find here is very much what you can expect in many central parts of Istanbul. It's a vibrant, authentic city, and that's part of its charm.
The room is ideal for a couple—comfortable, clean, and an excellent value for the price. The bathroom may be a little unconventional for some travelers, but it was perfectly functional and didn't detract from our stay.
What truly stands out is the location. It's hard to beat for exploring this side of Istanbul, with easy access to local cafés, shops, and attractions. Being just a short walk from the ferry is a huge advantage, making it incredibly easy to travel around the city comfortably and avoid traffic.
For the price, cleanliness, and convenience, this place exceeded.

Öncelikle mahremiyet konusunda sorun yaşamadık temizlik konusunda da sorun yaşamadık iletişim konusunda da sorun yaşamadık kısacası en önemli şeyler öncelikle olarak hiç bi sorun yaşamadık.

description: Discover Balat, one of the most charming districts in Istanbul. Enjoy relaxing evenings with sea views, explore the famous colorful streets, cafes and galleries right outside the door, and then relax in the private Jacuzzi. Perfect for couples, families and friends seeking comfort, style and a special atmosphere in the heart of the city.

reviews.text:
The apartment was decent and looked like the photos, but there were a few things that made the stay less comfortable. It lacked basic necessities in both the kitchen and bathroom — things like cooking essentials and toiletries would have made a big difference. There was also a strong humidity smell in the space that was hard to adjust to. Additionally, the stairs inside the apartment are quite steep, which can be tricky, especially with kids or luggage.
On the positive side, the host was very helpful and responsive. He arranged our airport transfers, which we truly appreciated and made arrival and departure much easier.
PS: The location is right in the heart of Balat, which is vibrant and beautiful — but it’s important to know that taxis won’t drop you off at the door, and the neighborhood is very hilly. Something to consider if you have limited mobility or heavy bags.

Positive:
The host is responsive, and also speaks German. The apartment is on the third floor and there is a side view on the Gold Horn from the living room.
The two bathrooms are rather new. The luxury is the Jacuzzi and the convenient location (3min to the tram station). Otherwise, the apartment is rather normal, but quiet. The kitchen comes with minimal equipment. In the smaller bedroom, there is a crib and an ironing board is there, too. Internet worked well for videocalls.
Negative:
There was a smell of old cigarette smoke.
There is only one A/C for the entire apartment, which means in summer you cannot close the doors of the two bedrooms as one would get too warm.

The place is well located and there’s a lot of restaurants and coffee shop around. The fact that it was on the third floor and no elevator was a bit of effort (we had 3 big luggage and a carry-on). The apartment was clean and as described in the listing. The AC was rushing a bit and made a lot of noises. We would have appreciated if there was some amenities like a detergent for the washing machine. Overall, it was a good place and I return to Istanbul, I will consider it strongly. Hoping that the AC will be fixed :)

The room was nicely organized, clean, and very comfortable.
The kitchen utensils and dishes were convenient and easy to use.
The TV was smart, so it was easy to watch YouTube and other content.
Having smart TVs in both rooms made the stay even more comfortable.
The ventilation was good, and the location was decent.
With just a short walk, you can reach shops and the market.
Overall, it was a cozy and great choice.
The stairs are steep, and the street is also uphill, so it’s something to be mindful of for small children and elderly people.
Great stay! The place was clean and exactly as described.The host was super helpful. Perfect location — would definitely come back!

description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally located place.

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at this chic two-bedroom apartment! The apartment is centrally located, offering easy access to the city's main tourist attractions and local amenities. The space itself was comfortable, clean, and well-maintained. I appreciated the self check-in process, which was seamless and made arrival stress-free.
The apartment has all the necessary amenities, including Wi-Fi, AC, and a nice balcony to enjoy the view. I especially loved the proximity to public transportation, which made exploring the city even more convenient. The host was extremely responsive and helpful, providing excellent communication throughout my stay.
Overall, this apartment offered great value, comfort, and a fantastic location. I would definitely stay here again during my next visit to Istanbul! Highly recommended!
It was a pleasant stay, matched the discerption and the photos. Friendly host. It not the best location there is a fair walking distance to the closest POI.

Honestly, the place is not far from the city center, but the road to it was tiring, and the place becomes scary at night because of the large number of intruders near it. Also, the bathroom was not of the required quality, as there was no hole to drain the water from outside the bathtub, and the bathtub was constantly clogged. The elevator is not large enough for more than two people with their bags, and the towels were not as clean as expected.

My family and I are extremely pleased with our stay at this Airbnb. The hospitality has been exceptional, and the level of service provided by Ceyhan and his team is outstanding. The property is not only well-maintained and comfortable but also ideally located with excellent access to the main tourist areas of Istanbul. You can easily find anything you need nearby, and the location offers convenient access to both the metro and bus services, making it easy to get around the city.
Ceyhan and his team have been very responsive, addressing any inquiries or messages promptly and professionally. Their attention to detail and commitment to guest satisfaction truly set this experience apart. Without a doubt, I highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a pleasant and well-located place to stay in Istanbul.
I will certainly be returning to this place for my next visit.

We had a great stay at Ipek’s place. It was as per Ipek’s description of the place. Nice and cosy and everything was clean. Ideally located for a great stay in Istanbul. Most importantly Ipek was responsive, available and easy to communicate. Ipek was a great host and i recommend Ipek’s place for a good stay in Beyoglu, Istanbul

description:
Situated in the Heart of Istanbul, right on Meşrutiyet Street, near metro station, 2 min to Galata Tower and Istiklal Avenue, simply location is unbeatable. The apartment was kept with the historic feeling of its 107 years old building with a modern touch.

Our apartment is recently renovated and brand new furnished. The building is equipped with an elevator (rare to find). We have specially designed this apartment both for couples and families/groups who prefer a peaceful and luxurious stay.

reviews.text: This Airbnb was exactly as described and located in a fantastic area - very close to many popular attractions, restaurants, and shops in the city center. Public transportation was also easily accessible from the apartment. The host was excellent with communication and provided helpful recommendations on things to do and places to eat. The only minor drawback was that the air conditioning could have been more effective, as the room did get a bit warm at night. It would also be a thoughtful touch to provide tea or coffee for guests. Overall, a great stay and highly recommended!

Very good, clean and comfortable apartment in the heart of Istanbul - perfect location with many restaurants and easily accessible by metro / Über! Walkable! Ali is a highly responsive host. Recommend!

This is a great centrally located apartment just minutes from Galata Tower. The space was clean and looked exactly like the photos. We loved the view of the streets right outside the window. Cordo and Atish were wonderful hosts, they were always quick to respond to our questions and even arranged an airport transfer for us. We’d highly recommend this place and would definitely stay here again on our next trip to Istanbul!

Great location, with easy access to Taksim and with a metra station two minutes nearby to get to other places. Its a well designed, tastefully furnished, and clean and comfortable apartment. Loved the washer dryer availability within our unit. The only possible negative point is the noise level. But its normal since it is in a central area of the city. We were not bothered by it as it dies out by midnight. Cordo is a very responsive and cooperative host. We enjoyed our stay very much.

Excellent location as you are within a few metres from Istiklal street and close the metro.
The apartment looks exactly like the photos.
The host was very responsive and provided clear check in instructions.

description: Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text: We found if quite easy and the location is great. They informed us our room was downstairs in the basement, there was a small patio like in the photos. It was smaller than it appeared in the photos. What we were not expecting was the most horrible smell of mould that the room had. Once we stepped in it was obvious but not unbearable, the windows and doors were open so, at first we reckoned we can stay one night and if it bothers us we’d ask to change. We returned later that night. Since the whole room was closed we were welcomed with the smell of mould already from the stairs, before we even went in the room. It was unbearable, so intense you couldn’t breathe, surely if we spent the night we’d get sick. We texted and told them our issue asked to change, they were happy to help us change but denied the existence of mould, they told us it’s because it’s an old wooden building and that’s the smell of wood. We changed rooms but ended up paying more. No AC in the 2nd room but with fans.

description: We intend to make every stay with us unique, just like every person who enters through our doors. We aim to be a place in the heart of Istanbul, one of the most beautiful cities in the world, that has served as the capital of the Byzantine and Ottoman Empires. Our focus revolves around creating an experience with local flavors and local DJs while blending them with world-renowned DJs.

reviews.text: The rooms are over a pub, but it was a good thing for me. Everything was clean and as described. Maybe I would have liked a little bit more information during the check in, but the guy was available via text 😊 the place where the hostel is located is very beautiful and full of life

I had a wonderful stay at this hotel 🤍 The people were incredibly friendly and communication was always smooth and helpful. The place itself was clean, comfortable, and had a very warm atmosphere.
One of the best parts was the location — it’s so close to the city center, which made getting around very easy and convenient. I truly felt at home during my stays and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a pleasant and stress-free experience 🍸
Thank you for the great hospitality!
Really good place for the price. We didn't find that it was that loud. the water was hot, the bed was comfortable, and the location was great!

I stayed in room 403 , it took 3 floors stairs to get there, the room is cozy and clean there’s a shearing salon beside the room for coffee or tea or reading
The cleaning staff are great, they cleaned the room even though I didn’t ask about it, the neighborhood is very nice beside it bars and cafes attracted for young people, so u can hear music during the day and night, i enjoyed my stay and definitely coming again, but my only problem is the shower water is not draining properly , and when I booked they didn’t tell me which room it will be and in which floor
The room was very clean and everything was exactly shown in the photos. The location was great, close to everything.

description: Fişekhane is an iconic landmark in Istanbul, surrounded by many famous restaurants, cafes, entertainment venues, and supermarkets. Our apartment is located just a few steps away from Fişekhane, offering visitors easy access to the heart of Istanbul. With its prime location, our accommodation is situated in a vibrant area where you can effortlessly enjoy shopping, dining, and entertainment. It is the perfect choice for experiencing the lively and dynamic atmosphere of Istanbul to the fullest.

reviews.text: Great host and good location. Parking was a worry but the host was very helpful in arranging one. The street nearby is active and full of life. 7 minutes walk to Fişekhane was a plus. Host was very hospitable and supported us throughout check in, parking, cleaning and check out.

Great location for access to the train station for central Istanbul. Lots of local restaurants which are affordable as well as a more expensive option for dining out only a few minutes walk away. Parking was a bit tricky to find but host was able to help me find a spot for free or you’ll have to wait for one to become available.
Great residence and friendly employees, clean and comfortable, i advice everyone to stay at this place , near to store and 3 min walking to marmaray metro
New place, very nice location. Train is a bit bothersome, but not worth mentioning. There were little uncleaned spots, but after mentioning, we got a cleaning and apology. Would definitely recommend.

This location was amazing and extremely convenient. There were many shops and cafes to enjoy within just a 2 minute walk. It was also only a 15-20 min cab ride to Fatih to see main tourist attractions. The host was very helpful and accommodating! We loved our stay and would gladly come back.

description:
NEWLY RENOVATED! 4AC’s-75” 4k TV, the way of apartment contains 2 flights of stairs which may not be suitable for guests with mobility issues . Free Bellboy services provided on demand.
A modern and newly built apartment where you can have a pleasant time while watching the unique Bosphorus view of Istanbul from your comfortable living room and bedroom.
The location is very central and walking distance to the Galataport,Taksim,Tram,Bus Station,Taxi Station. One of the safest area of İstanbul.

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay! The apartment was even better than the photos. It was very clean, comfortable, and in a great location.
The hosts were incredibly kind and helpful. They helped us carry our luggage up the stairs when we arrived, and they also helped us again when we were leaving. Our flight was very early, so we had to leave at around 2:00 AM, and despite the late hour, they were there to help us without hesitation. We really appreciated their kindness and hospitality.
The only thing to note is that Uber drivers sometimes had difficulty finding the exact location, and there are quite a lot of stairs if you’re walking down to the Bosphorus. However, this wasn’t an issue for me since I wasn’t traveling with elderly people or young children.
Overall, we had a great experience and would definitely stay here again. Highly recommended!

This was my very first time using Airbnb, and I couldn’t have asked for a better experience! The apartment in Istanbul was beautiful, clean, and exactly as described actually, even better in person. The location was perfect for exploring the city, and everything we needed was within walking distance.
A huge thank you to Bedirhan and his amazing team for being incredibly helpful and responsive throughout our stay. They made sure we were comfortable, gave great local tips, and truly made us feel at home.

Clean apartment with best view that you can find in entire Istanbul!
Very responsive host. They helped us with luggage (which is a big thing), transportation (which was cheaper and more comfortable than at the airport, so I strongly recommend to arrange through them)!
The location is not far from Galata port, Taksim and Galata( walking distance)
There is one thing that you need to consider before booking; the entire area is up on a hill and you will have to walk the steps even to get to the cab.
We had a stroller, kid and a disabled person and it was very challenging for us.
But that’s not the host’s issue of course, but entire area.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
We had an amazing stay at this apartment. The owner was extremely kind, flexible, and very reliable, with fast and clear communication throughout our stay. Everything was so easy — whenever we needed anything, it was provided straight away.
They even helped with our luggage, carrying it to the apartment and back for us, so we didn’t have to lift or carry anything ourselves. The apartment was very, very clean, and we were pleasantly surprised to receive cleaning service twice during our stay, which was amazing. They also provided water for the entire stay, which was very thoughtful.
The view was absolutely beautiful, and the apartment itself was comfortable and well looked after. We truly felt taken care of.
Definitely, definitely we would stay here again if we come back. Highly recommended!

We stayed here for a week as a group of 4 adults and 3 kids. The host and co-host were great—very helpful, responsive, and easy to communicate with. The apartment was clean and had a nice partial Bosphorus view.

Overall, a very good stay. I’d rate it 4.8/5 due to the location. Best suited for groups without kids or mobility issues.

Location was perfect for me. It is a bit off than approximate location shown in the listing but still very close to Yeldegirmeni. The room I stayed was 403 which was different than I booked. Awesome stay! The location was perfect and the host was super helpful. Would definitely come back.

I stayed here a couple of nights. The place had everything i needed, and was good value for the money. both the hosts and people staying there were friendly and helpful. I definitively enjoyed my stay, thank you for having me 🙂

description: Relax with the whole family at this peaceful place to stay. Our place is located in a bustling area with a shopping mall, restaurants and cafes, beauty salons, and a mosque nearby. reviews.text: Great stay at Fatih’s place in Istanbul. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described, with a perfect location for getting around the city. Fatih was very responsive and helpful throughout, making everything smooth and easy. Would definitely stay here again.

We had a fantastic stay and would happily recommend this Airbnb. The location was excellent and made it easy to explore Beyoğlu and the surrounding areas. Fatih was an excellent host, always very responsive and ready to help with any questions we had before and during our stay. There was always staff downstairs, who were incredibly friendly, and happy to assist whenever we needed anything.
The apartment itself was spacious, with a great layout spread across two floors, which made our stay feel very comfortable. Despite being in such a central location, we didn't hear any noise from the surrounding area, so we slept really well each night.
Overall, it was a wonderful experience, and we'd definitely stay here again.

The host was very friendly, welcoming, and helpful, and the reception staff were also very accommodating. The apartment was clean, the furniture was in good condition, and the bathroom was clean as well.
We also really enjoyed having access to the shared area at any time. The rooftop terrace was beautiful, and the garden downstairs was lovely.
The location was excellent — very close to everything and just a few steps away from Istiklal Street. It’s a very lively area, full of life, restaurants, cafés, shops, and plenty of things to do.
Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this place.

Location is ideal for tourism on the European side, lots of walkable options for restaurants and sites to see. The host was very friendly, responsive and helpful. The door person was very friendly as well. We had an issue with the AC and he made sure to resolve it. Great value, would recommend!

Konakladıgımız ev konum ve temizlik olarak çok iyiydi. Biraz yukarısı istiklal caddesi ve taksim meydanına çıkıyor. Ücretsiz park yeri bulmak biraz sıkıntılıydı fakat biz halledebildik. description: Cozy 1BR flat with a balcony in Taksim360 — just a 5-minute stroll to Istiklal Street and metro. Sleeps 4 with a queen bed and a comfy convertible sofa. Full kitchen, Smart TV, fast Wi-Fi, washer/dryer, private safe, and elegant decor. The balcony is accessible from both the bedroom and living room — perfect for morning coffee or evening vibes. Baby crib and high chair available upon request.

reviews.text: The apartment was exactly as shown in the photos and very clean. The host was friendly and responsive, which made the stay smooth and comfortable. All necessary services are available nearby, and the location is excellent—close to Taksim Square and most major tourist attractions. Highly recommended.

Overall it is definitely one of the best places I have stayed from cleanliness to safety and responsiveness it was all 10/10. I even asked if they could possibly do something for me and they did it without giving a ridiculous price which I really appreciated.
If I was to nit pick about the apartment itself it would be sometimes the water in the shower would go cold and you have to adjust the temperature again but it was never a issue to the point where I had to complain and im sure if I did they would fix it immediately also the AC not sure if we could not figure it out but there was 1 day where it was quite warm and I tried to set it to blow cold air but even though I can hear it on, the room wasn’t cooling down much but again nothing too major.
The biggest problem which unfortunately they cannot control is the traffic noise it doesn’t end like at all, all throughout the night cars honking every second and sirens etc. This was the biggest issue but I understand they cannot control.

Spotless apartment with everything you could possibly need for a comfortable stay. The location is excellent, with shops, restaurants, and attractions all within walking distance. The hosts are incredibly welcoming, cheerful, and always ready to help. The apartment is secure, and the surrounding neighborhood is clean, safe, and peaceful. I truly enjoyed my stay and will definitely choose this place again on my next visit. Highly recommended!

We enjoyed staying at Erhan's place. The location is excellent within 5 minutes walk to İstiklal street. Check in and check out was very easy too. We felt safe there. He is also very responsive and helpful. The photos are accurate too. Will stay here again if i am visiting Istanbul. Thank you

The apartment is amazing!

reviews.text: The space looks as shown in the photos. The location is very central, it's something like a service apartment than an airbnb, but served well for my solo travel. Fantastic Airbnb, prime location close to amazing restaurants and nightlife and easy access to the metro tram and bus lines. The room itself was spacious and clean, some noise heard at night in the distance but that’s to be expected seeing as so central. Hot water all the time, lovely little balconies. Staff were great, very helpful and welcoming. Would highly recommend this place.

We had a lovely stay at this hotel. It's in a great location and the room was clean with a nice balcony and air conditioning. There are friendly and helpful staff at reception 24/7 and the host is very communicative with great suggestions on local activities.

Location is amazing for the price. Staff is very friendly and helpful. Room is a bit humid and the bathroom/shower is okay. The bed is two twin size beds pushed together. Overall worth the money to stay in this area, and at this hotel.

Great place if you’re in Turkey to stay. Coming from the UK or US you have paid more for less amenities in this countries. The hotel sits on a hilly street, very quiet, but be aware you can’t have guests overnight. I will book again when returning to Turkey in the future.

reviews.text: This is a room and bathroom separate to but connected with Cheer's hostel, so expect there to be a number of backpackers around at breakfast. Do not book this if you can't walk up flights of steep stairs or have large luggage. The place was clean and air con worked well, bathroom is good and the mattress is comfortable. If you are tall, please note this is a loft and has low ceilings. There are no cooking facilities. The location is quiet as it is down a small back lane and it is very convenient for the major historical sites, Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, etc all within a short walk. It is also close to a tram stop and train station so you can get around the city. The disadvantage of this area is that is crowded with tourists and local restaurants charge inflated tourist prices. So a bit pricey but location good for museums.

Wow, Perfect location on a quiet street! Just 5 minute walk to Topkapi Palace, Hagia Sophia, the archeology museum (amazing), Hippodrome, and a few minutes more to Blue Mosque, Grand Bazaar and spice market. Room was quiet w double paned windows, lots of light, blackout curtains were great, large bathroom with quick flowing hot water. Mattress was very new and comfortable. Low fragrance w light wood pine? scent. Staff at Cheers Hostel just across the small street was very helpful and friendly. Bottled water, for our room, breakfast and coffee were free. Patio was fairly private. For Old Town / Sultanahmet / Fatih we’d stay here again. Room was exactly as described and perfect location. Note—no coffee or hot water heat if you want tea in the evening but there was an unusually quiet mini fridge.

Thank you for a lovely stay! The location was perfect—just a short walk from Hagia Sophia and all the beautiful sights of Istanbul. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. I truly appreciated your hospitality and quick communication. I would be happy to stay here again on my next visit. Highly recommended!"

We have had a fabulous time
Our room was spacious, clean and comfortable
The terrace was beautiful with a wonderful view of Hagia Sophia
We had breakfast in the cheers hostel over the road - also owned by Onur.
The staff were extremely friendly and helpful
We had a fun evening in the bar at the top of the building - with a free belly dancing show
They organised dinner cruise for us and helped us navigate the tram system
The location was perfect - close to shops, restaurants and the main sights such as the Topkapi palace and Blue Mosque
We would definitely recommend!

If you want to be in the old town and walkable to all the main attractions then this is a good spot. Quite a basic room but comfortable mattress and great bathroom. It’s part of the Cheers Hostel opposite so they were able to accommodate our 2.30am check in which was very helpful.

description:
Historic & Restored Cozy Apartment Near Taksim Square (350m)
Welcome to Istanbul, the city of civilizations! As a psychologist and an avid traveler, I love hosting people from all around the world. I know exactly what a traveler needs for a comfortable stay.Our apartment is located in a newly restored historic building, just 350 meters from Taksim Square. You can walk to the metro station, airport shuttles (Havaist), bus stops, historical landmarks, and trendy cafes within 10-15 minutes.

reviews.text: A good stay overall - the location was excellent and the room was good value. However, the listing created expectations that didn’t match the room. The street-facing picturesque façade appears multiple times in the photos and the staircase shots are taken from below looking up, which gives an impression of the balcony pictured being the room advertised. Whilst the room is titled ‘garden-level’, it is in reality a basement room facing out to an overgrown garden with rubbish. The room is still good value, but the reality was not as bright and airy as pictured and expected. The balcony itself was unclean - an old crisp packet, cigarette butts in the ashtray, and an unclean floor. Toilet seat was also completely loose. Street wasn’t too noisy for us, but upstairs neighbours quite noisy in the morning. There is a kettle and coffee machine but no tea or coffee provided. Convenient base, great location, but clearer photos, better cleaning, and basic maintenance would improve the experience.

I had a wonderful stay and highly recommend this place.
The apartment was very clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was excellent, with easy access to public transportation, restaurants, and many of Istanbul’s main attractions.
The host was extremely kind, responsive, and always ready to help whenever I had a question. Their hospitality made my stay even more enjoyable.
Thank you for your warm welcome and excellent service. If I visit Istanbul again, I would be happy to stay here again. I highly recommend this accommodation to anyone looking for a comfortable and pleasant stay

We had a generally good stay the apartment itself was clean and matched the photos. However, the location is on a very steep downhill slope, which makes it quite difficult both to walk down to the apartment and especially to walk back up, for example when you need to reach a taxi. This was particularly challenging with luggage.
Another issue was the internet: it didn’t work for three out of our five days, which was very inconvenient. And on the last day the electricity in our room went out, so we were without light.
Overall, the stay was okay, but these things are important to be aware of in advance.

I absolutely enjoyed my stay here despite after coming realized I needed a place with kitchen and a desk :)
However, hosts were very friend, understanding and responsive when I had to shorten my stay.
Anyway the place is really nice - very easy to find, nice neighborhood, lots of uphills and downhills but totally worth it. The room is quite spacious and very clean. There's also a balcony where one can sit and enjoy sun; bathroom was also clean and had all necessary amenities.
Would definitely recommend it!

Very pleasant stay in Istanbul. The accommodation is in a great location, close to Taksim Square, which makes getting around the city very easy. A big advantage is the proximity to the metro, as well as nearby restaurants and shops. The room and bathroom were clean, comfortable, and well maintained, exactly as described. The only small downside was the view from the balcony, which was not very appealing, but it did not significantly affect the overall experience. I would definitely recommend this place.

description:
Our flat is just 5 minute to famous Galata Tower karaköy and Istiklal Avenue where you can find the best restaurants, cinemas, pubs, gift shops, shopping centers of Istanbul. It is also the main street around Taksim and In addition, it is only 2 munites to Galata Bridge and Karaköy tramway and there are also nice fish restaurants and coffee shops under the Galata bridge. very close to şişhane and golden horn metro station.

But it's near the bus and metro stations, you can access in 5 minutes on foot.

reviews.text: Wonderful stay overall. The location near the river has a spectacular view and a very calm, peaceful atmosphere. The place was clean, comfortable, and the outdoor umbrella was a very thoughtful touch for both sun and rain. The host was very responsive and communicative, and check-in was extremely easy. The only small downside was that the TV is a bit old and sometimes has trouble connecting to the internet, but it wasn’t a big issue. I would definitely recommend this place and would happily stay here again whenever I visit the city.

Ozan Bey rezervasyon yaptırdığımız andan itibaren bizimle sürekli iletişim kurdu. Her sorumuza hızlı bir şekilde cevap verdi. Yerin konumu harika, temizliği ise gayet güzeldi. Odanın içerisinde yeteri kadar malzemenin olması sebebiyle ekstra bir şeye ihtiyaç duymuyorsunuz. Ancak Ağvada yeteri kadar yemek yeri yok.
