description:
Sophisticated 1BR in a restored 19th-century building, just steps from Galata Tower.

The cozy bedroom offers breathtaking views of historic Istanbul, including the Golden Horn and iconic Süleymaniye Mosque.

A modern bathroom, full kitchen, and stylish living room blend heritage with comfort.

Step onto your spacious private balcony to soak in sweeping views of Galata’s rooftops and the Bosphorus.

A rare gem for those seeking beauty, history, and a view to remember!

reviews.text: I'd like to point out that the apartment matches the description and photos exactly. It's very clean and bright. Everything necessary for a stay was provided, including toiletries, a coffee machine, and good Wi-Fi. The host is very friendly and approachable. The location is in the heart of the historic city center, 20 steps from the Galata Tower. There are a huge number of cafes, and the bay is just a 10-15-minute walk away. The only drawback of this accommodation, which is worth considering when planning your trip, is the noise. From the living room windows, you can hear music and cafe patrons until 3 a.m. It's not intrusive, but it's still audible in the background. From the bedroom windows, you can hear loudspeakers from the port at night, as well as chanting from mosques at 6 a.m. In addition, activity on the floors below can be heard from the stairs. I would say the apartment lacks soundproofing on the windows and doors. Travelers should be prepared if they have trouble sleeping.

The accommodation exceeded our expectations from the moment we stepped through the door. It instantly felt like home, with a spacious living room and kitchen, and we were impressed by the size of the bedroom. We ended up cooking on all four nights of our stay, and the apartment was equipped with everything we needed.
The location is really convenient—there are three supermarkets within walking distance, plenty of shops nearby, and the famous cheesecake shop right downstairs near Galata Tower. The area stays lively even till 1am, but it didn’t affect our sleep at all (perhaps cos we were on the 4th floor). In fact, we enjoyed watching the buzz from the balcony.
It’s also very well connected, with bus, tram, and train stations close by, getting to the main attractions was easy.
Daria was also responsive and helpful throughout our stay, which made the experience even more enjoyable.
Note: the apt is on the 4th floor by stairs only, we got help from the cafe staff for our luggages.

We had a wonderful 5 night stay here, a great spot with fantastic views from our 4th floor balcony and bedroom windows, loved getting a breeze from 2 directions. Easy downhill walk to buses and tram.
Daria always responded really quickly to any questions and was very helpful.
The unit was exactly as shown. Very comfortable bed.
The guys working in the cafe below were friendly and helpful with directions.
The only thing I would say is to be aware there is no lift, and it's 4 floors up, so if you have any major mobility issues it may not be the place for you. I have had 2 knee repacements and I was fine and got faster and stronger each day 🙂
A beautiful, comfortable space that I felt very safe in and would happily stay again and recommend

I was very charmed by this lovely apartment and felt right at home! It is beautifully clean and very comfortable. it has everything you need for a smooth trip. It is steps away from the Galata Tower on a main street, so there is lots to do, but it is also a very busy area that gets super crowded. In the bedroom with the door closed it is quite quiet for the most part. We occasionally had difficulty finding an even temperature in the shower. Also, keep in mind that the apartment is on the fourth floor up windy stairs which can be tiring, but also great exercise! Excellent value for money at this apartment and I recommend it.

We spent one night, transitioning from Cappadocia to flight home the next day.

reviews.text: A great hostel with great staff. They answered any questions I had, they helped me book a taxi for 5 am flight, book a covid test, booked my Turkish Bath at the Hamam. They had suggestions for restaurants to check out and things to do. The rooms were clean. The hostels location is amazing just a short (2 min) walk away from Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque and Topaki Palace. 10 - 15 min walk to the Grand Bazaar. I'm pretty sure the Basicilica Cistern is very close by too. I would recommend to anyone visiting Istanbul

I had an incredible stay at this hostel! The atmosphere was welcoming and relaxed, and everything was clean and comfortable. But what truly made the experience unforgettable was Fati, the host. He is absolutely incredible so kind, helpful, and genuinely attentive. From the moment I arrived, He made me feel right at home. Whether I needed directions, tips on where to go, or just a friendly chat, Fati was always there with a smile. His warmth and hospitality truly made this place special. It was truly the best airbnb experience I’ve ever had, thank you for everything 😊

İlk defa hostel de kaldım. Çok rahat uyudum. Yatak, Temizlik, kahvaltı, kısacası her şey süperdi. Onur ve ekibi güler yüzlü yardımsever ve çok iyiler. çok teşekkür ederim . Teras bar harika çok beğendim.

If you are a backpacker is a good place to stay. The place is close to the main touristic sites.
Unfortunately we found it a little dirty, especially under the bed where there were used water bottles, hairs and trash.
The hotel is very well located with a good view of the sea. The food in the restaurant is extremely good with a fair price besides that the staff make the atmosphere extremely pleasant and relaxed =)

description:

It has its own private balcony and a terrace upstairs with a wonderful view.

reviews.text: The place was exactly as the photos except a few minor things like the building doesn’t have elevator it was OK except the lights was really dark for the stairs the parking is really difficult in. The neighbors are really rude. They don’t allow anyone to park. And the noise was crazy. From the apartment downstairs. Even the people in the building and street start shouting at them. They were drunk having a party.
Merhabalar mekân temiz güzel ve çok rahat konumda sık sık tercih edeceğim yerlerden biri oldu .
Sonuçta konum belli tarla başı ama bizi rahatsız edecek hiç bir şey yaşamadık fiyat performans olarak gayet memnun kaldık

Great apartment with a beautiful balcony and access to roof top terrace. Great value for price, and convenient location to transport, supermarkets and nightlife. Only thing to keep in mind, especially female travels might feel unsafe in the surrounding neighbourhood at night, even though it’s only a 100 meters walk to the busy street and the street of the Airbnb itself felt safe, I wouldn’t recommend wandering around in its side streets at night

description:
Located in one of Istanbul's most historic neighborhoods, our apartments are just an 8-minute walk from the Hagia Sophia and Topkapi Palace and a 5-minute walk from the Blue Mosque. Offering easy access to the tram line, this exclusive accommodation option combines the unique atmosphere of the past with modern comfort.
We are happy to welcome you to our new, modern apartment:) (:

reviews.text: We had a great stay here. Dilek was very responsive to all our questions and was very friendly. The place was very clean and quiet. I enjoyed the location as it was extremely close to the blue mosque and the other things we wanted to tour. The AC was great and sleeping was very quiet which was lovely. The bed itself was very hard but everything else was perfect so I really have no complaints. The washer was great too and they had a clothing rack to dry all our clothes.

We had a great stay at Dilek’s apartment. The location is excellent, within walking distance of Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque, and other main attractions in Fatih.
The apartment was modern, comfortable and very clean which was especially important to us. Dilek was responsive and helpful throughout our stay.
We definitely recommend.

The apartment is very clean and cozy, with a modern renovation. We were among the first guests after the apartment was newly renovated, so everything felt especially fresh and well-kept. There is everything needed for a comfortable stay. The location is excellent — Sultanahmet is within walking distance, which is very convenient for tourists. Many thanks to Dilek for her hospitality, care, and responsiveness! We were left with only positive impressions and would gladly recommend this place.

Great stay overall. The location was excellent and easy to access, and everything was exactly as described. The place was very clean, comfortable, and well maintained. A pleasant and convenient stay—I would recommend it.
Excellent location, clean and comfortable facilities.

Absolutely fantastic stay! This was one of the best Airbnb experiences we’ve had. The apartment was spotless, modern, comfortable, and had everything we needed for a perfect stay. We truly felt at home and would highly recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Istanbul. We would definitely stay here again on our next trip. Thank you for your wonderful hospitality!
Accomodation exactly as described . Great location and host was so friendly , knocking on to say hi and apologising for not being there when we checked in very late at night !! Thankyou Zeki !

Zeki's place was at a perfect location for us to explore the part of Istanbul we wanted - he always responded quickly and was helpful and quick with all of our needs. He let us leave our luggage after check out which was also very comfortable and helpful for us. Thank you, Zeki!

Zeki is a great host, i had a mistake in my reservation and need to change the date at the very last minute (on the day itself) and Zeki been very accommodating to help me get a place to stay.
The place super close to city center, we just walk our way to Hagia Sofia (no public transport needed). But if you need train or taxi, it is also available (train station just few min away). Couldn’t recommend his place enough if you looking for place near to city center. Worth every bucks paid!

Zeki is a really great host. I book this place at the very last minute and he make it happen at the cheap price too. He is also friendly with my father and my family. This place is at Fatih so its really near to attract places like Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia. I really recommend this place for those who want a cheap price

description:
Experience Istanbul from a unique and peaceful stay in the heart of Balat, one of the city’s most vibrant and historic neighborhoods. This cozy room offers a stunning sea view, private balcony, and a relaxing jacuzzi, perfect for couples or solo travelers.

Wake up to panoramic views of the water, enjoy fresh air on your balcony, and unwind in the jacuzzi after exploring the city.

reviews.text: The bath was unusable as it leaked into the downstairs. The host was, however, very apologetic and since the room next to us had a bigger jacuzzi and was not rented, he let us have the keys and use the one there. It was an inconvenience but I understand it wasn’t expected and happens. Under the circumstances, he did the next best thing in trying to fix it. He was prompt in communicating and fixing the situation as best possible. The view was amazing and room was very clean. The stairs were very difficult but doable.

Konum olarak güzel ve ulaşım ağlarına yakın. Jakuzi çalıştırmayı bilmiyorsanız öncesinde bir info alarak gelmenizi tavsiye ederim. Ev sahibi sorulara çok hızlı yanıt verip her ihtiyacınızı karşılamaya özen gösteren bir yapıya sahip. Fiyat performans açısından güzel bir yer.

description:
This private room is located on 2nd floor in a shared flat. Flats location is 2 minutes away from Sishane metro station & main Istiklal Avenue surrounded by historical atmosphere of local attractions.

! VERY IMPORTANT NOTE ! Its a shared flat with 3 private single rooms with huge shared kitchen, so only 3 people are sharing this flat. This private room and entire flat is AVAILABLE ONLY FOR FEMALE GUESTS. Please make your request due to this reminder.

Wi-fi speed is 100 MBPS fiber!

reviews.text: First of all, the host is kind, careful, and helpful. Secondly, the location has a good and a bad side. It is two or 3 minutes walking to İstiklal taksim and Galata. It has also a police station and it is a plus for safety. Concerning the negative side, it is so much noisy. In the morning, there is a school full of noise, and in the evening there is a bad music and a man who always screams and makes lots of noise. Concerning the house, it is full of old furniture, the fridge and dish washer is so noisy and old, the entire house is dusty and the walls are dirty. The living room is full of boxes and the TV doesn't work. The fridge again is so small and doesn't fit four guests, the kitchen is so small and you can barely walk in. There was an open closet in which we put our food,it is opposite to the toilet which is an awkward and odd thing for me. The floor made of wood is damaged and makes so much noise. The bed is stiff and uncomfortable. All in all, the house is not as in the pictures and expected, the location is good but so noisy.

The room I stayed in (not the one in the picture) is great. Simply and charmingly furnished, I t's light and airy, was peaceful when I was there, and even has a balcony through the beautiful stained-glass French doors. Nothing was lacking. The kitchen and bathroom were shared with the friendly long term resident exchange students.
The location is excellent and I really enjoyed Ali's recommended neighbourhood restaurant. Ali is a considerate host who was easy to contact and prompt in replying. Highly recommended.

My stay at Ali's place was relaxing and comfortable. The room was exactly as described in the listing. The place is in an excellent location close to most attractions reachable by foot. There are abundance of restaurants, cafes, and shops just around the corner. Even though it is centrally located, the neighborhood was quiet and safe. Ali was helpful with my questions and needs. I ended up extending my stay another week. Highly recommended for budget travelers looking for a comfy place to stay in Istanbul.

Ali's place was in an extremely convenient location just around the corner from Istiklal Caddesi, easily accessible to shopping and eating out. It is also quite close to a metro station which can take you straight to Taksim square within 1 stop (alternatively you can take a 20 minute walk down Istiklal Cd. to get to Taksim Square). He was really helpful during my stay there and my room was also quite comfortable. I would definitely recommend his place for anyone wanting to stay somewhere close to an area with a vibrant nightlife.

Ali was a very welcoming host! He responded quickly to all my messages.
Location of the flat is perfect (very close to central metro staion). The flatmates were nice.
The only problem may be the loud noises from the college students outside in the morning-noon, but if you go out (for work or sightseeing) they won't bother you. In the evening it is all quiet, but you only have to walk 1 minute to get to the Istiklal street - to see the colorful Istanbul nightlife. Prices in the district are higher than on the asian side, but the location is worth it.

Али - отличный хост! Быстро отвечал на сообщения в ватсап, встретил в 9 вечера. Соседи по квартире - иностранные студенты/учителя, говорили по-английски. Проблем не было, жила месяц. Единственная проблема - напротив колледж, студенты по утрам шумят, иногда играют в баскетбол. Но вечером/ночью тихо. Очень безопасно - от метро 2 минуты, можно приходить домой поздно вечером. Но в то же время всего 1 минута до улицы Истикляль, где в любое время есть открытое кафе\клуб.
Очень близко к метро, от которого можно быстро добраться до любого района Стамбула. Отлично для фрилансеров - рядом Старбакс и коворкинг (по дороге к Галата). Цены в кафе дороже, чем на азиатской стороне, но местоположение того стоит.

description: This nice flat is only 1 minute walk to Beyoglu/Istiklal Street, which is the heart of the city and center Taksim. Istiklal Street is between Taksim and Galata where all the restaurants, cafes, bars, antique shops, art galleries take place

reviews.text:
were a couple and we spend 4 nights at the apartment. firstly, the apartment is extremely well located and its close to bars, shopping and convenient stores. more over, its right on Istklal street but in a rear street so it is very quiet and peaceful. also, the apartment is very close to Taksim square and to public transportation. secondly, the apartment is very specious and the rooms are big and can easily fit a party of four- for us, a couple, it was very nice- moreover, it has a good electric heaters. however, the bed linen and blankets were small and a little dirty and i hope it will be fixed.
Mehemet was not not around but he was very accessible and responsive, and helped us in all we need. to summarize things- the apartment is defiantly worth the money, and can be better with minor adjustment regard the bed and cleanliness of the apartment.

The apartment is located right near Isticlal st. and Taksim square. This is good but has its demerits: it is in ancient blocks of old downtown, narrow and dirty streets, even a taxi driver doesn't know the way there. The apartment is on the third floor, rather steep stairway, no elevator. Leaking shower cabin, only one electric socket in each bedroom (and surprisingly two in 1.5 sq. m. bathroom), the old woman from the second floor with very sharp hearing, really good woofers on the first floor (i liked his musical choice, but anyway :) ). Two adults and two children, we paid €75 for one night. No offense to the host, but if you are alone, you should expect much better service in the hotel for €50. For a family, i dont think it is good choice for that money.

Mehmet is a great host and his apartment in central Taksim is very lovely and amazingly quiet.

We were the first guests so everything was very clean, tidy and in perfect condition.
As Mehmet was renting this apartment out for the first time, it could have happened that something was missing. Knowing that, Mehmet offered to be available anytime in case we needed something – and he was. Everything we needed was taken care of. The Wifi had not yet been installed at that time so he was making sure we could use the neighbor’s Wifi for the time-being. Also, Mehmet showed us around in the neighborhood and gave us some recommendations as to where to eat and buy groceries. In short: Mehmet made everything necessary for us to have a pleasant stay.

As for the apartment:
The living room/kitchen is small, but very cosy and comfortable.
It is perfect for people who would like to spend most of their time outside exploring the city. At the same time it offers enough space to have a breakfast, dinner or to chill-out together at the apartment.
Although we didn’t make use of it very often, everything is provided for cooking: stove, pans, cutlery etc …
As the apartment generally is cosy yet small, I would recommend it for friends, family and couples. Two couples, however, might appreciate some privacy which, due to the physical proximity of the rooms, might not be perfectly available.

The benefits of the location cannot be exaggerated: it is literally 2 minutes from Istiklal Caddesi, the main shopping drag in Istanbul. As it is in the center of Taksim area there is an abundance of shops, bars and restaurants. As such it is perfect for exploring. Little stores, bars and cafes are very close in one of the little streets nearby. Amazingly, despite the central location, it is unbelievable quiet. As all windows are facing the courtyard so we would wake up in the morning not knowing whether it was a weekday or weekend. There is no street noise whatsoever audible in the apartment.

In conclusion: We very much appreciated the stay in Mehmet’s apartment and I would go there again to enjoy Istanbul right in the center of the action.

Mehmet's place is the perfect place if you want to be in the middle of it all. It's very accessible and just 5 minutes walk to Istiklal Street - the place to be in Taksim. It is exactly as depicted in the pictures. It's clean, organized and the kitchen is complete with cooking utensils. It's on the 3rd floor though of an old building with no lift - so it would be a hurdle for old folks and those with heavy luggage. Though it's near Istiklal street where you'll find lots of shops and bars, it's pretty quite at night and secured as it is very near a police post. We did not get to meet Mehmet in person, but he informed us before our arrival and gave us the contact of his friend, Mon, who received us and provided all the needed info.

This is a fantastically located apartment, minutes from lively nightlife and restaurants. We found it a perfect place to return to after days out exploring the sundry delights of the city. Neat, clean and well appointed, we couldn't fault it. Being at the rear of the building ensures that it is quiet as well. We stayed for nearly a week and if we ever return to Istanbul, we'd be keen to stay in Mehmet's flat again. Our two kids (13 & 6) enjoyed it as well.

It is minutes walk from İstiklal Caddesi and Taxsim square making transport connections really easy. We arrived and left via airport bus to/from Taxsim Square. The airport bus stop is a short walk away. Likewise, the Metro is moments away with the Taxsim funicular that connects with the tram at Kabataş a very simple, fast way of getting over to the older part of the city at Sultanahmet. We also caught the ferry from Kabataş dock to the Princes Islands; a worthwhile day trip.

Mehmet is the consummate host; warm and genial, you couldn't meet a nicer guy. He gave us a terrific array of recommendations; places to go, sights to see and decent restaurants to eat at.

We wholeheartedly recommend this apartment to anyone coming to stay in Istanbul. Beyoğlu is such a fabulous neighbourhood, we wanted to airlift the whole locality to inner Sydney.

reviews.text:
Mert is an absolutely phenomenal host. The suite is exactly as described. Very clean, two beds, a kitchen and a private bath. It is located in a great location walking distance to a large chunk of tourist locations.
But I would like to thank Mert specifically for being such a great host and ensuring we had a safe, comfortable and enjoyable stay. From the time we checked in he ensured we arrived safely and comfortably. We were a couple hours late due to taxi issues. When we finally arrived, Mert was waiting for us outside, carried our bags to the suite and gave us a tour of the area. During the large heat wave that hit istanbul, Mert checked up on us to make sure we were okay. He provided amazing insight on things to do in Istanbul with lots of tips to stay safe and avoid overpaying. This is only a summary of the great things Mert provided during the stay. I will certainly come back. Overall, this was a 10/10 stay that I highly recommend to anyone. Thank you, Mert!

Mert has a wonderful place—very comfortable, clean, and spacious. The location is perfect being almost directly next to Taksim Square. There are many shops and restaurants all within a block or two. Because the apartment is only up one flight of stairs, it is ideal for anyone who doesn’t want to walk up multiple stairs. The street is steep outside, but this is common in most of Istanbul, so there’s no way around having hills to climb.
Mert very kindly did my laundry and had cleaning services. I stayed about 3 weeks, and really appreciate Mert’s continual kindness. He offered to get me water or other basic necessities from the nearby convenience store a few times. I don’t think you can find a better location with a kinder host in Taksim area. I’m very happy to have stayed here.

Mert is a great host. the place is very nice. as the photos posted. it has everything you might need during your stay.
I would probably consider some additional cleaning work to be done on the stairs and some areas in the apartment.
The bed is comfortable, there is a nice area to have a meal. the TV is rotational so you can watch it on the bed or on the sofa.
I would request for better towels. the studio is quiet for a peaceful night sleep.
the internet needs some improvement, the strength is weak in the room and speed isn't very fast, I had some drops and that interrupted my work for a while, had to use my own data tethering from the phone.
I would prefer to have access to the washing machines+drying, since Mert is usually not in the place unless needed.
overall I would definitely come back as he as well has other rooms to stay at in the building. Mert gave me some information about turkey and tips to follow.
thank you Mert for having me!

I stayed for a week almost. Apartment looks better than on photo. All stuff work. It has central heating. Environment is very cool and pretty quiet.
Apartment was clean on 100%
Host knows about hospitality on 100%
I got very good service for a very comfortable price.

Mert was a great and welcoming host! He met us right from the taxi and helped us with the bags, the same happened on our departure. He was caring about all aspects of our stay very well.
The studio is as advertised: small but has everything you'd need. First floor (second above ground), but it's not a problem. Bed, sofa and a kitchen with almost anything for cooking. Personnel will help with anything you need (cleaning, some supplies). Wifi is good. The only thing, that I think is common in Istanbul in this time of year, is that it was a bit cold sometimes, but the AC was helping to keep the temperature up so it wasn't a great problem.
The house is on a street that is inclined almost 45 degrees, so keep that in mind. 20 meters up it gets plain though: Taksim square is just meters away, but no noise is heard in the apartment, as it is 2 streets away from traffic. You can get to pleasant "hotel area" near the square or main streets of Istiklal and Sıraselviler in 3 minutes. So the location is quite central.
Overall, big thanks to Mert for making this stay so comfortable.

description:
Our apartment is located in the central district of Beyoglu (Taksim Square)
Comprising a bedroom with double bed, a living room, a bathroom with bath and a fully equipped kitchen.
You will have free and unlimited wifi, air conditioning, tv, washing machine, dishwasher, hot water 7/24 and all the comfort you need.

The apartment enjoys an open terrace of 25m2 with breathtaking views of the Bosphorus. (ideal for aperos, dinners)

reviews.text: Very good communication from the host, Deniz was there for us at all times if we ever had a problem. The house looks the same as the pictures, the terrace was outstanding, especially in the night. Very good service overall, around a 3 min walk from Taksim square. However if you dislike stairs, this might be difficult for you as it is on the 4th floor, other than that everything was clean and stocked up. Would definitely come back, the location is excellent and in a safe area. Great value for the price. Deniz was very welcoming and accessible by phone at all times.

Unfortunately, the apartment is not up to standards and is different from the pictures. The apartment smells really bad, there were many personal belongings left everywhere (closet, bathroom, kitchen). The bathtub is not in good condition and the outer space is dirty and not appealing at all. Furthermore, the apartment wasn't clean.
The location is indeed very good, there is a nice view of the Bosphorus and you get the feeling of being in a very local spot of Istanbul.
Deniz was very friendly and polite throughout our communication and she agreed to give me a refund. What was off was that she requested a screenshot of a nice comment posted about them because nobody did this before. She said that this was all she needs to be sure she is not getting a bad comment from my side before issuing my refund.
That's not the spirit of the Airbnb community (I hope) hence I am posting this review.
I hope that Deniz had just a bad day and that my case was only one incident.

We had a very comfortable stay at Deniz’s place. Check-in was very smooth, and when it comes to check-out Deniz was very kind and flexible since we needed few more hours (after the original check-out time) due to our flight time.
The place was clean. Kitchen and bathroom was adequate, and AC is working in case of they are needed in a hot summer night.
Apartment is on the top floor and it is very rare to find a building with elevator in Cihangir area, it is just to keep in mind and be prepared if you are coming with several heavy bags like us :) It was still ok for us anyway since we were not expecting elevator.
5/5 for the place and stay.

The location is very good, and the flat is rather spatious and well-equipped.
However, we had some problems during the stay. The host that met us spoke no English at all, and failed to explain that there is a main key set of two keys for the apartment door, and a separate additional key from the stairs door. As a result, we took only the main set of keys with us, and later found ourselves not being able to enter the house from the street. Thanks to a helping heighbours, who opened the stairs door for us. The stair itself is very steep, narrow, and without light.
The bathtub is very old, stained, and atop of that had some dirty streaks. We had to clean it ourselves, which cleaned the streaks, but left the stains intact.
The wifi is very weak. The information in AirBnB listing promised fruits plate and wine, but none were present.

Well-located apartment with an excellent terrace with a view to the sea.
Deniz was an excellent host, kind and timely.
The apartment was clean, just very old and some parts could need some renovations (like the closet). The public areas in turn were slightly untidy.
Unfortunately, during our stay, neighbours downstairs had some very aggressive fights and other disturbing behaviour which unfortunately affected our stay and caused discomfort.

description: Apartment is fully furnished and equipped with all stuff you need during your stay. Its located at the heart of Taksim and its just 100 meter away from Taksim Square. Also in walking distance to all public transportations. The area is the most chosen area in Taksim.

reviews.text: The apartment was located right in the center of Taksim Square — everything was within walking distance, which made exploring Istanbul so convenient. The check-in process was smooth and easy, and the building felt very safe and secure. There was hot water available 24/7, which was a big plus. The host was extremely helpful and responsive throughout our stay, always ready to assist whenever we needed anything. Overall, a great experience and highly recommended!

You couldn’t ask for a better location for a tourist visiting Istanbul! Just a couple of blocks from Taksim Square, you can easily walk to several local landmarks, and the amazing Istanbul public transit system will get you anywhere you need to go quickly and affordably. The apartment is on a quiet side street, and both the building and the unit itself are peaceful and well maintained. The place is a bit older, so it shows some normal wear and tear, but it’s clean and comfortable. The hosts are amazing, very friendly, responsive, and always helpful. I would definitely recommend this stay for anyone visiting Istanbul.

I had an amazing stay at Engin’s apartment in Istanbul. The location was perfect — right in the center of Taksim, which made everything extremely accessible. I could walk to restaurants, shops, and transport within minutes.
Engin was an exceptional host. He was kind enough to let me leave my bag in storage while I traveled, and I was able to pick it up when I returned to Istanbul with no issues. That small gesture meant a lot and made my trip so much easier.
Overall, the apartment was comfortable, the location unbeatable, and Engin himself was incredibly nice and helpful. Highly recommended!

Place is nice and cozy.
You can move the sofas around to make a makeshift bed.
Hot water and clean bathroom.
Located very close to taksim square and thr metro station.
Internet was super slow so that was the only problem, rest was great!

Excellent central location.
Deniz and Engine was very helpful.
Very clean and comfortable apartment, equipped with everything you need.
It's a wonderful feeling to be at home when you go to Istanbul. I will always take it. It's wonderful.

description: This property is located in Fikirtepe, Kadikoy. Merely 400 meters away from Cumurriyet bus station, 10 minutes walk to Akasya Mall. 12 minutes walk to Uzunçayır Metro Station. The location of the building is on a wide road with no noise of traffic, the views are so beautiful from the building. The entire building is new and modern with 24 x 7 security.

reviews.text:
This property is located in Fikirtepe, Kadikoy. Merely 400 meters away from Cumurriyet bus station, 10 minutes walk to Akasya Mall. 12 minutes walk to Uzunçayır Metro Station.
The location of the building is on a wide road with no noise of traffic, the views are so beautiful from the building. The entire building is new and modern with 24 x 7 security.
The flat has nice space, very neat and clean bathrooms, furniture and fixtures in excellent condition, the kitchenette looked beautiful in white color. The fridge, oven and rest things were sparkling clean.
It was memorable to stay in this property for me and my family. We have tiny kids around so stay with them was safe as there were no balcony or open windows, the flat has central air conditioning with climate controls in every room and living area. The lighting ambiance was beautiful in the evening.
The hosts Ayhan and his brother have been very helpful, they were very calm, nice and motivated.
Ayhan's brother communicated with us in English and he's been superb in responding to WhatsApp message. Both brothers have been very helpful in everything we asked for.
I wish'em best of luck with their AIRBNB hosting business.

The apartment is exactly as described and as you see it in the photos. Very clean and stylish, comfortable and calm. The swimming pool on the second floor is awesome with amazing views. The apartment offers beautiful views as well, you can see the Bosphorus from there. If you walk down to Mandira Caddesi you have access to a nice neighborhood where you can get everything you need. From there, it is a 15 minutes bus ride to Kadikoy center. On the other side you can walk to the huge Akasya mall.
We had great fun watching films , relaxing in the pool, exploring the neighborhood.
The area is very safe and Savash and his brother are very helpful and respond immediately to messages. I can definitely recommend this place!

For the listing price it's a great place to stay. Hopefully in the next decade the view will improve. I was split between a hotel or the listing, and I was not disappointed for choosing to stay at this location. The host had left everything from shampoo to dish washer pods and wonderful super-hot green peppers in the fridge. Utilities are great, the only trouble were the electrical sockets which didn't work in the rooms. The owner was aware of the issue, he apologized and said he just didn't get around to getting it fixed. Over all it's much better if you have a car in Istanbul, otherwise the uphill walk from the 24/7 market will leave you out of breath. There is 24/7 security in the lobby area who also patrols the entire site. I felt very safe on site. The pool is great but not very deep (about 5 feet), so as a tall person you'll have to sit to submerge. The neighborhood felt as though it's under construction. Here sits this wonderful modern building towering over an old and cheap looking neighborhood. Breakfast at Simit Sarayı every morning was awesome, and it's right downstairs.

We had an excellent stay. The building is nice, the apartment is nice and met our needs as a family of 3. The kitchen was well stocked for us to be able to cook. Delivery drivers found us easily. We communicated with a Ibrahim who was very friendly and communicative. He quickly helped us with requests for a fan (since the smaller bedroom did not have a/c) a hairdryer, and even a new mattress for the bed. The apartment is about a 20 min walk to the nearest metro station Unalan. There is a nice playground for kids nearby, the neighborhood is very residential and safe and full of coffee shops. There were only a couple of restaurants, but food delivery is easy in Istanbul. We would stay here again.

Ayhan’s place is perfect for 2 couples or a family. We were 2 couples and it worked well with two separate bathrooms and bedrooms. Kitchen had everything you need for some basic cooking. When we asked some extra equipment, it was provided without delay. Apartment is on the 10th floor which provides nice side views with sunsets over the water, all the way to the European side of Istanbul.
+ Spacious apartment with nice view.
+ Close to the Metro and couple of good enough grocery stores near by.
+ Quick communication with the host.
+ Nice personnel at the building reception.
- AC wasn’t turned on at all in the whole building complex so it got quite hot during the days.
- As foreigners, it was challenging for us to sleep through the megaphone sounds from near by very early in the mornings.

description: The building is located in Istanbul’s arts, entertainment, history and cultural district, in other words right in the middle of the city center, in Taksim / Beyoglu.

reviews.text:
Unfortunatly we can not recommend the Apartment, throughout there are some positive aspects we had too many negative things to handle.
Pros
- Our hosts answered very fast
- The shower was cold one morning and they fixed it within a day throughout it was end of ramadan
- From the flat you can reach the Istiklal street by 5-10min walking, Galata tower was 20min walking
Cons
- The Apartment in general was not clean and run down (e.g. baseboards were loose, side of the fridge was dirty). The pictures on airbnb are much better as the reality
- The door has to be locked otherwise it continues to open
- The lock of the door does not work properly, it is very difficult to lock up twice. This is dangerous in case of an emergency
- The wifi connection is not stable, there is no internet for about a minute/ every 15 minutes
- The lamp in the bedroom is cold white and way to bright to use it
- One chair had a dirty mark
- The dishes were not clean and wet, so that we didn‘t used it
- There was only one fork
- The bed was so hard that it was uncomfortabel to lay on the side
- It‘s loud in the flat. You can hear if someone next to you opens a door normaly, also the small street is loud (loud cars, honking, sirens in the night)
- The bathroom sink was way too small. It was not possible to brush your teeth or wash your face normaly
- The shutter could only be hooked if they were closed. So we had no daylight because the wind closed them constantly and we had no opportunity to fix it.
- My travel budy is allergic to milbs. He reacted as soon as his head lay down on the pillow. As he put a sweatshirt between pillow and his head, his airways became free immediatly

Taner is a very nice an helping host with a lot of knowledge about the city and the neighborhood. He's responding quickly to any questions or requests you may have.
The flat is nice and roomy with beautiful decoration and everything you need for your stay. It is located in a quiet neighbourhood. Still you'll reach many restaurants, shops and attractions in a few minutes walk or with the tram or bus.
We had some furniture that turned out to be more used than on the pictures in our room and the shower could've been cleaner. Also notice that smoking is allowed in the appartments. Ours didn't have a bad smell but we could recognize some other guests smoking when we were in the staircase.
All in all it is a very good appartment and service that Taner offers if you can accept the small caveats.

Good place for short term staying - relatively well located and furnished.
Pros:
⁃ apartment was authentic and had spirit of antiquity
⁃ there is an elevator in the building
⁃ cozy view on the street and local houses
⁃ lots of shops, bakery and groceries nearby
- very welcoming host
Cons:
⁃ really disturbing noises from street starting 7 am (cars, people voices, door slamming) and from the inside of the house as well (loud steps, voices, doors, etc.)
⁃ no welcoming bottles of drinking water, tea, dry towels, etc. (but there was salt, sugar and oil)
⁃ one of the armchairs was broken
⁃almost no bath supplements (only towels and hairdryer)
⁃ the apartment needs refurbishment - lots of tiny dirty spots / corners
⁃ bedroom door was really insecure and with no door handle inside the room
⁃ radiators were barely warm (we were staying in early march)
⁃ only two small mirrors
⁃ bathroom pipe was leaking (a little, but disturbing), so did showerhead

Taner’s house is exactly what it looks like in the photos on Airbnb. It is located in between many touristic attractions and is close to Taksim. Furthermore, the house is supprisingly airy and extremely clean. The apartment even has an elevator which is not common in houses located in older but more central parts of the city.
Last but not least, Taner was very helpful during our stay in his house.

Çok tesekkurler!
The hosts were so kind helping me with check in and check out. The apartment was clean and perfect for my short trip of two days. The location is handy to Taksim Square, about 5 minutes brisk walk with small grocery stores nearby. I found the area to be safe compared to some areas in istanbul - however I am a man so this was easier for me. There is a busy street nearby and also Istikal CK too so there is always people walking and commuting which helped me feel at ease.
The bed was comfortable and the shower was great too.
The hosts were very kind and communicated very well to any questions or requirements I needed for my stay and I am very grateful.

description:
Guest access
Room cleaning is done every fifth day of your stay. All linens and towels will be changed on these days. Special room cleaning requests can be made by contacting the manager.

Other things to note
All guests who will stay must share their ID or passport.

It is mandatory for all guests to share their ID or passport.

reviews.text: One of the best experience on Airbnb. The room was clearly as in the pics. It was extremely clean. The bed was so comfy. Bathroom was clean and in very good condition. The terrace was great. The location is superp. It's 2 minutes to Istqlal street and 2 minutes to Galata tower. Ali was great host. He was very helpful. The check in experience was fantastic and it was around 1 am. Ali put 2 bottles of water in the fridge which helped me a lot as I arrived from the airport very late and couldn't have the energy to go an look for grocery to get water. The only thing to consider is you must climb a stairs as the room is in the 4th floor and it was not an issue for me at all. Many thanks Ali and I hope to stay with you again in the future.

As many former guests already pointed out, Ali's place and the whole handling (check-in, tips for transport etc.) was fantastic!
The flat is small but definitely big enough for 2 people (I stayed there on my own) and has everything you need: a dangerously comfortable bed (I slept VERY well there), a nice clean bathroom, good water pressure and hot water in the shower, good heating, a very clean and big fridge, a closet with hangers, a water cooker for a quick tea or coffee, enough(!) towels, enough outlets (both at the bed and at the table/workspace and a very nice terrace which I didn't use due to the cold weather in December. In summer it must definitely be very nice to sit there with a glass of wine or a beer!
The place is perfectly located within the nice and safe neighborhood of Beyoglu in a very quiet street which is nonetheless super close to the next metro station (Sishane) and the tram station (Tünel) which leaves you right next to the Galata bridge and provides you with transport to Sultanahmet, the piers and all the major sights. The neighborhood has many shops for musical instruments, souvenirs and good food as well...
Ali was a very nice host and the communication could not have been any better. Just ask him anything, he will deliver ;)
Self check-in is possible and worked fine!
For transport from the IST airport get a Istanbulcard, take the Havaist bus (18 lira) to Taksim square from where you can either walk or take the metro to Sishane station.
My favorite tip: take a ferry to Kadiköy (only 3 lira) just before sunset and enjoy the ride to the asian side and then enjoy some of the good food they offer there, plus there will not be many fellow tourists...
So, 5/5 would book again, I'll not waste time looking for anything else the next time I'm around!
János

Nice place near Galata tower.
1. Good place near Galata tower. So many historical objects would be in your comfort walking radius.
2. Near Galata there is noise, craziness, a lot of people. But near this place its really quite.
3. Nice terrace.
4. A lot of cozy places nearby to have great breakfast of good cup of coffee in the evening.
5. Transport is nearby.
6. Ali is really friendly host.
But also there are things you should know.
1. To get to you room you should pass stairs. So be ready to go upstairs 4 levels.
2. Try to close the shower cabin door well. Or you will face little lake in your bathroom.

First, I’d like to say that Ali answer our questions very fast. It was a last minute book and he helped me a lot. The location is perfect! You won’t regret it at all. Everything was clean, the end is very comfortable and the room with terrace is amazing. The hot water was amazing!
Only one thing: if you have a heavy baggage like me, be prepared to go upstairs lol. I took off all the heavy things and went up and down twice. ;)
100% recommended, I’d comeback for sure!
Gayet güzel hoş bir yer. Baktığınızla karşılaştığınız birebir aynı ve temiz. Fiyat performans açısından sizi üzmez. Konum güzel. Ev sahibi kibar ve hızlı dönüş yapıyor. Tavsiye ederim.

description:
Our place, a historical building , is centrally located in Beyoglu which is in the historical area of Istanbul. we just finished renovation and furnishing.
The place is 10 min walk away to Istiklal Street, bars, traditional restaurants, and night clubs. It is also very close to historical places such as Eminonu, Sultanahmet, Galata. The metro and bus stations are 1 km and 350 m away, respectively.
It is located in the residential area. So it is important to be quite after 10 pm.

reviews.text:
The hosts are wonderful, truly kind people who provided me with everything to make my stay comfortable and lovely. The space is nicely decorated. Small but adequate and cosy. Very clean. The neighbors upstairs seem to have committed to hitting the 10,000 steps mark at night. You can hear their footsteps and the walls are thin (Not the hosts' fault of course). In the day time the neighbors seem to compete in a furniture moving competition.
Anyway, I digress - The apartment is very well maintained. It's small and cosy, but value for money. It's close to the metro, bus and tram stations. It's cleaned once a week (not sure if this is mentioned in the description but may be relevant to some people). There's one little window so the place can sometimes get a bit stuffy. I'm a little claustrophobic so I'd keep the door ajar until bedtime, so I wasn't bothered much because I kept the door ajar. The hosts were nice enough to make arrangements to make my stay as comfortable as possible. As I said, the hosts are lovely and the place worked for my stay given my schedule of activities.
The caretaker, Yavuz was so incredibly helpful and polite! I found him to be very hardworking, genuinely concerned and committed to making guests feel right at home on behalf of the hosts.

We stayed in Hakan & Turkan place for 4 weeks it was the best place I have stayed in beyoğlu Istanbul, very very clean it was exactly as it looked in the photos, beautiful interior ( really) quiet street, location is just perfect, 5 min to the bus stop, istiklal street and Taksim square are in walking distance, amazing apartment has everything you need for comfortabl stay, great hosts, friendly and helpful staff, check in was great,definitely will come back again and will recommend it to my friends, families and colleagues.

Hakan & Turan were very responsive and helpful, always answered very quickly whenever I had a question. Everything was exactly as described, location was very safe and quite central to everything I needed. As a solo female traveller, safety is very important to me and I felt that very much at this location. Honestly, I would even say the price I paid was way less for the price this location deserves!!! Highly recommend this to everyone visiting Istanbul.

The apartment was very clean, well-furnished and well designed. Furniture and household appliances are new. We stayed in winter, so the fact that there is a central hearing system was very convenient. The apartment was warm and had no problems with hot water. The yard outside is nice, it would be perfect to sit there with a cup of coffee in spring/summer. The location is great, quiet neighborhood. Istiklal street is 10 minutes away by walking. Both Sishane metro station and Taksim are not far either. There is a bus station just 3 minutes away.
The hosts met us and helped to settle and were available in case of questions. We had absolutely no problems during our one week stay. Greatly recommend this apartment

Everything was as expected and as described. It’s easy to find, located near Taksmi/Istiklal and many public transportation hubs.
The host was very receptive, he also let us to late check out and deposit our luggage for our last day.
The house it’s really pretty, you have all you need for a holiday.
The only problem, and it’s not host’s fault, the neighbours (they are really loud, at every hour of day and night, seems like they are moving the furniture every minute of their life).
For the host: change the water switcher for the shower.
Hope to be back soon!

description: Providing free WiFi, Oval Flat offers accommodation in Istanbul, less than 1 km from Column of Constantine, a 12-minute walk from Blue Mosque, St. Sophia and Topkapi Palace. Grand Bazaar is 450 meter from the flat the flats come with a wardrobe. The flats have a private bathroom, a kitchen fully equipped, . Living room is equipped with a flat-screen TV and comfortable sofa(which can be double bed also.). The flat is prepared for comfortable stays

reviews.text: Elvin was an exceptional host,responsive, kind, and professional throughout our stay. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Check-in was smooth, and the location was very convenient. Highly recommended!

The location was fantastic within walking distance of everything. I really liked how it is connected to the hotel Miro mansion next door because they have 24 hour reception and were always helpful, eg helped me to discern a good vs a bad taxi driver for the airport early in the morning!
The flat was a little dated though and with thin walls. The photos make the place newer than it is and the carpets were old and dirty. Towels can do with a change too as one had a hole in it. Cleanliness was okay, can be better.

My trip ended sooner than expected, but Elvin and his brother were kind enough to give me a partial refund. The apartment was what I expected, though it is a little smaller than the pictures. It had everything that I needed. Location wasn't bad either, with Hagia Sophia and Blue mosque being 15 min away walking. I arrived early and the apartment was still bring cleaned, so they invited me to their hotel next door for tea and cake. Any time I saw them they offered something to eat or drink, they are generous hosts!

This place is exactly as it is shown in the pictures. Very spacious, clean, practical and fully equiped.
We travelled with our 1 year old and this place was perfect for us. They provided a crib and a high chair. TV is smart so could watch cartoons on Youtube.
The hotel two doors down is associated to this AirBnb (maybe same owners) so the 24hr reception really came in handy with late check ins, requests and luggage storage post checkout.
Only downside is that the area is not all that fancy- a bit industrial with many wholesale shoe shops. While the tram stop is about 8mins walk its a relatively steep uphill. So bear that mind.

Perfect location for our first time visiting Istanbul--super close to all of the major sites and attractions in the city. As others noted, no AC in the bedroom but we actually found the room very comfy for sleeping so it was not an issue. Nuri was also fantastic as a host; super flexible and easy to communicate with. Overall, we recommend this place as it was great value!

description: Experience the magic of Istanbul from its most iconic neighborhood. Our hotel, located in the absolute center of Old city Sultanahmet, offers a blend of traditional hospitality and modern comfort. Whether you are here for a short visit or a long stay, our goal is to make you feel right at home while you explore the history right at your doorstep.

reviews.text: The price and location made our short stay in Istanbul perfect. The check in went smoothly and the reception staff at the Camelot Hotel were quick to provide recommendations and ways to get around the city. The room is definitely on the small side (looks larger in the photos), we struggled with space for our bags without walking all over our items. The bathroom is also very small, would be ideal for a single person or a couple with minimal baggage! The air conditioning worked perfect, and the place was exceptionally clean for our stay. We also found the street very quiet for sleeping at night which is an added bonus! Would stay here again :)

Eser and the others was very friendly and the place is very clean and suits for couple however the room is “very cozy” so don’t suits if you have 4 or more luggage but it is comfortable , quite, romantic and you will find lots of restaurants , bars , cafes 3 minutes walking.
It is near The historical palace (aya Sofia, sultan Ahmed)
They very responsive and handle my concerns of the room with other option with a city view at once free of charge.
Room service was provided every day.
They provide a airport taxi service for me with market value.
The internet was good.

The location of the hotel is great which is only 5 mins away from the main mosques. The hotel recipient is very friendly and helpful. Room is a bit smaller than expected but it’s clean. Overall, it’s a good price to stay.

Overall a good hotel. The perfect location if you want to visit the main sights in the city. Many restaurants and other stores nearby. The room and the bed were not very big but it was clean. The staff was super friendly and very helpful. We also booked the airport transfer that was organised by the hotel, which was a bit cheaper than an Uber.
Perfect stay for a short trip to Istanbul!

Great location and great host! I ended up having to book a short stay in Istanbul and this hotel was a pleasant surprise. It’s within walking distance of food, shops and the Bosphorus River. The staff was very hospitable, and the hotel was clean. In the process of making last minute plans, Eser arranged an extended stay as well as transportation to the airport. WiFi is strong as well. Highly recommend staying here.

description:
The place is a one-room studio apartment with a bathroom inside.Double bed with a good enough space. Including a bathroom which are fully equipped. "dry cleaning" is with extra fee, i am geting your clothes, i am washing, after i make iron, i am giving your clothes back same day or the next day.
The cleaning will be done everyday by our staff free of chage.Besides, the wi-fi are free of charge!

reviews.text: Our room had a leak due to some clogged gutters on the roof and the staff came right away to fix it. They cleaned our room and went to the roof to fix the cause of the problem within a few hours. None of our things were damaged and the service was good. We would say that the WiFi isn’t really great so if you want to work from the hotel or watch movies, get your own WiFi, but for messaging and short YouTube videos it’s fine. The service - cleaning, help from receptionists, and shuttle to the airport is great. They’re really helpful in general.

This hotel is nothing like expected, the room looks nothing like the picture, the location is not accurate on the map, there is cockroaches all over the bedroom there’s barely no housekeeping, the electricity doesn’t work (i have proof) the Wifi was terrible please avoid this hotel!

It’s not an entire apartment, it’s a room in a hotel. Although it is located near Taksim square, the neighbourhood is not very good, there is not even asphalt on the road near the hotel and a lot of dirt. The room is near the reception and there is a lot of noise from there. The bed is not very comfortable and the internet in the room hardly works

Oytun's house is located in a very central spot, which is a big plus, and we booked it thinking it had a kitchen. Upon arrival, we were given a small room with a bathroom and toilet, but no kitchen. This was resolved after several days, as they allowed us to use a kitchen on another floor. Furthermore, everyone was very kind and helpful, and we were able to extend our stay for a few more days without any problems. Thank you, friends.
Good for the price. Location is very close to Taksim. Entrance to the hotel was broken and there was quite of mud there

description:
Orange 1+1 is serving under name the Blue apartment at perfect point that only one minute from Taxim Square. Location is center of Istanbul and it is compeletly safe and clean.
The Apartments renoveted and have all things that you need for personel comfort.
Managed by professionels like a hotel but you feel like at home

reviews.text:
Excellent stylish apartments that are a pleasure to stay in. Photos fully reflect reality. The apartment is clean and bright due to artificial lighting, which compensates for the lack of light from the Windows. Everything you need for life is in the apartment: detergents, dishes, spices. Erhan is a very hospitable host. He quickly answered my questions and covered all my needs.
The apartment is located in a great tourist location. 5 minutes from Taksim square and Istiklal street. Galata tower is a 15-minute walk away. To the coast about 20 minutes on foot. There are many small cafes with nice prices and chain grocery stores nearby.I am very happy that I chose this apartment. Thank You, Erhan!

I am very grateful to Emre and for his hospitality. If there were more than five stars, I would put it. He is a friendly, sympathetic, calm person, and speaks excellent English. He helped me a lot. As for the apartment, it is comfortable and clean and has everything a traveller needs, such as a kitchen, bathroom, Air conditioner, hairdryer, iron, hot water, refrigerator, sofa. The bedroom is comfortable and all the covers are clean. As for the location of the apartment, it is a great location because it is very close to Taksim, the metro and the bus stop. Also, the location of the apartment helped me because there was a pharmacy and a barbershop below the Apartment. I wish success and continued success for this work.

cozy and comfy flat, same as the pictures, extremely near to taksim and very good location, and host is always responsive.
for me everything was fine and the price is worth it but the only negative point I can mention is that there is no washing machine inside of apt.

The apartment is super central and Emre is really helpful and nice - however, it is pretty dark and therefore a bit depressing, the washing mashines are in the hallway and super busy (hard to find a timeslot when they are empty and free to use). There are some ants in the kitchen, which is for sure super hard to change and also not that alarming but the flat is equipped with only the most necessary things: bed lamp is broken, no possibility to prepare coffee in the flat, no kitchen towel. This is not really welcoming for the price paid. Emre makes up for it with his helpful and friendly character, his flexibility and his quick answers for any issues though.

Stayed 2 weeks @ blue apartment the location was perfect and the hosts were excellent i connected to Wi-Fi very easily
This apartment was excellent value for money & I would definitely stay here again. Highly recommended

description:
My house is located in Taksim, the most beautiful district of Istanbul. 3 minutes walking distance to restaurants, entertainment venues and the Metro. 40 seconds to the famous Taksim Istiklal Street.

My house is clean and comfortable. It has 2 bedrooms, 1 small living room and kitchen. It is very suitable for a family.

NOTES; The apartment is on the 4th floor and there is no elevator in the building. If you want, we can help you with your luggage or you can use the self-check-in feature

reviews.text: Ali's place was as described, clean and easily accessible, and within a walkable distance to Taksim Square. Loads of restaurants and public transportation around. Thanks Ali for hosting us.

I would like to say about the apartment so people don’t get scammed by this host ..the location is ok and Ali respond this is only good thing nothing else… the walls are dirty ,next to the bed where the window is like they never clean it has a lot of hairs and dirt on the floor it smell bad inside the host leaves the trash in front of my doors 2-3 days I don’t know why after he take old trash I had new one .. the place has a lot of humidity I really don’t recomend this apartment.I write this commentary so people know the real picture..and aircondion didn’t work good ..
Located close to Taksim Square. The host was very helpful and communication was easy. Comfortable apartment, great for the price
Everything was as it appeared in the photos. The house was very clean and comfortable. The location is close to everywhere. Thank you, Ali!

Ali is an incredibly warm and kind host, and his accommodation is impeccably clean and conveniently located. It's worth noting that if you're traveling with older individuals, accessing the place might be a bit challenging, but Ali provided us with a helpful route to Taksim. The apartment's proximity to Taksim, Istiklal, and transportation hubs makes it an ideal choice for exploring key tourist areas in Istanbul. I wholeheartedly recommend this place for a delightful stay during your Istanbul travels.

description: Our beautiful modern and well decorated 3 bedrooms dublex is located in the heart of istanbul, Ulus. Close to one of the most visited area 'Ulus Park' Zorlu Shopping Mall, Akmerkez, Nusret Steak House and Ortaköy. it's waiting for you to enjoy its comfort and wonderful forest view. It is centrally located and close to public transportation.

reviews.text:
The apartment was nice and has a good location - not too far from the city and easy to take a bus near the apartment. Gulay was also quick to communicate back when we had question for her which was appreciated. She had an extra person who was co-hosting which we could contact as well. Although we must also admit that some “smaller” things were not working (and we informed the hosts about this). The fan for upstairs bedroom was broken, so our friend had to sleep in uncomfortable heat some nights. The Wi-Fi was lacking an entire day. We asked if possible to get an extra key (cause we were 3 people living there), which we were informed was possible. The co-host would bring the key and also check upon the things that wasn’t working, but he didn’t show.
The biggest issues though was bedbugs in one of the rooms. We informed the host about this and the host indirectly accused us for bringing them to the apartment. This was not possible since bedbugs lives in the apartment/furnitures beforehand. Our friend got bidden by them and had marks and rashes all over her body and the room
Was inhabitable. I had to spend the most of my last night in Istanbul texting back an forth - which influenced our night.
The host arranged for a “pest Control” who had to spray the apartment (and our clothes) the day after. We was told that we couldn’t be in the apartment - we were rushed out the apartment 10 in the morning and we couldn’t get home until 18:00… this made our last day very stressful and uncomfortable. We got home, and there was still bedbugs in her bed, so she had to sleep on the couch.
In the end it felt like the hosts just wanted us out of the apartment and only texted us to make sure that we had checked out in time

The apartment is very clean with all needed amenities and supplies
The owner is very responsive and give us all clear instructions to reach the place
Checkin is very smooth
Location is what we’re looking for outside the hustle and bustle of touristic area but in a centralized location the view from main bedroom is nice the parking is a plus our main concern is the air condition it is only in leaving area which was not a problem downstairs but it was hot in upper floor room but we are lucky that weather was good during our stay I will stay here again and I definitely recommend the place
Great location everything is as described clean, safe neighborhood very quick response from the host thank you !!!

My stay at this Airbnb was absolutely wonderful! The host was incredibly welcoming, responsive, and accommodating. The property was just as described and provided a clean and cozy atmosphere. I couldn't have asked for more in an Airbnb experience and would highly recommend this accommodation and the Superhost who runs it - they certainly meet all expectations of a Superhost!

I stayed for 8 days with my family at the property. And glad I chose Paul and Gulay’s property. Both have been a top host from reservation stage and throughout our stay. Very proactive and really professional.
The flat is great just like the pictures, felt like being in my home.. Quite, clean and easy access. There are taxis available to wonder into great parts of Istanbul.
Also Zorlu centre is very near for a quick shopping and offers many places to eat. Will definitely be back.
Thank you for having us!

description:
WELCOME TO OLD CİTY APARTMENTS
‘'With the most competitive price, in the comfort of Turkish hospitality as you were in your own home, in the heart of the Oldcity ...'’
During your staying you will be helped by special and unic stuff and you will be pleased with the friendly atmosphere of the “house”. At Old city.
3rd Floor Apartment , aparts with elegant decor complete the comfort of “home away from home”.
Please note that upstairs can be reach only by the stairs. We don't have elevator.

reviews.text: great stay in Istanbul. the apartment is as described. located right above a 24 hour cafe, moments walk from numerous resturants and a few minutes walk from the metro (Kumkapi station). apartment itself was clean and tidy as described and a great value base to explore Istanbul (especially if 4 people are staying).

The apartment is located on the third floor with no elevator, which can be inconvenient if you have a lot of luggage or mobility issues. Additionally, the building next door was completely demolished, giving the area a somewhat abandoned feel. I also noticed that the towels and bed linens had a musty smell, likely because they weren’t properly dried.
Another point to consider is that the apartment is situated at a busy intersection, and you can hear car horns until 1 or 2 AM and again starting at 7 AM, which can make it difficult to get a good night's sleep. While the apartment is close to a tram stop, you have to climb a rather steep hill to reach it, which can be tiring after a long day of sightseeing.
On the positive side, there was good communication with Murat, who was responsive and helpful throughout the stay.
In summary, the apartment would have been fine if I had paid less for it.

I had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb! The space was clean, cozy, and exactly as described. The host was incredibly responsive and thoughtful, making check-in and communication a breeze. Located near shops and restaurants. Highly recommended!

Everything was great. The location was nice and the neighbourhood is very walkable with lots of restaurants and markets around. The place was exactly as described and very clean. The only downside was that the flat is on the 3rd floor and there is no elevator, so it was a bit hard for us given all the luggage we had, but it was not a big deal. I would recommend.

The apartment was small but nice, with everything we needed for our stay. It’s in a great location - walking distance to main attractions and plenty of restaurants. It was clean, though not spotless. A couple of downsides: the A/C in the bedroom is positioned directly above the bed, so cold air blows right onto you at night, and the shower was missing part of the glass, so you have to be careful to avoid splashing water outside. Overall, a comfortable place in a convenient area.

description: Modernly decorated with sun light and centrally located in the heart of Istanbul, Taksim - a few mins walk to Taksim Square, only 5 mins walk to Istanbul Convention Center (ICC) & ICEC. Also a short bus or tram ride from touristic site Sultanahmet.

reviews.text:
Located five minutes by foot from Taksim square in a side street with a few shops and restaurants the apartment was in walking distance from everything you might need (also metro and bus stations for further attractions like Blue Mosque, Hagia Sofia etc). The big shopping street Istiklal Caddesi is about 10-15 minutes walking distance and provides you with high street fashion like Topshop,H&M etc as well as local shops and an uncountable amount of restaurants, bars and clubs.

The apartment is located on the 2nd floor in a house that only has a few neighbors (we actually never saw any). Note that there is no elevator in the house but unless you have real trouble taking the stairs it is no criteria.
The apartment is very spacious, it was recently renovated and had a modern interior design with very nice decoration. It has a living room with AC, two sofas (apparently you can open one up to make it a bed), a flatscreen and two more sofa chairs. The dining room has an open kitchen that is fully equipped (+dishwasher,washing mashine) and a big dining table. The bathroom is modern and has everything you need from soap to hair dryer. There are two separate bedrooms with double beds that were very comfortable to sleep in. The air conditioning in the living room also spreads into the rest of the apartment so were able to escape the heat (avg 35 C° outside). One bedroom has a small winter balcony were you can hang laundry. The overall impression of the apartment was amazing! Since the apartment is usually being lived in it has a very homey feel and is equipped with everything you need.

Deniz and Ercan sent us a self-made city guide and provided us with info on how to get to the apartment before the trip. They came to pick us up from the bus station (where the airport bus Havatas stops, Taxim), showed us to the apartment and stayed to chat about Istanbul and everything we needed to see. We were even provided with soft towels, branded shower gel,shampoo, coffee and a welcoming package in the fridge with fresh milk, cereal, bread, eggs and even homemade jam from her mom. For using public transportation, they left a metro card called IstanbulKart that up to five people can use together and top up at every station. We were blown away by their hospitality!

Their tips on where to eat, drink, what to try and see and their insights of locals were priceless. I know I am raving, but Deniz and Ercan have set the bar pretty high for airbnb hosts! They are a very welcoming and open minded couple who love travelling themselves and have made it one of their goals to make their guests not wanting to leave again, which they definitely succeeded in. We have made great friends by meeting them and there is no doubt we will come back again!

Deniz made us feel very welcome, she gave excellent directions on how to reach the property and met us outside. She provided us with fresh fruits, tea, cherry jam (which is made by Deniz’s mom - that I can not forget the taste), coffee, granola, eggs, milk etc. items in the fridge for breakfast, which were amazing. The apartment was better than the photos; comfortable, clean and homely. A tasteful, generous interior design and everything you needed was there from water kettle to detergent (and even a dish washer was there), from white fresh towels to soap dispenser and comfortable bed for a good night. It has superb location, 10 minutes from Taksim and metro, that makes it perfect for visiting Istanbul by walking or if you want to use public transportation. I can say that the description of this listing is very accurate. Highly recommended!

We had a very comfortable and enjoyable stay in Deniz's apartment.

Deniz made us feel very welcome and was very accommodating. She provided an abundance of useful information about Istanbul, things to do and see and places to eat.

The apartment was as described/pictured and better. It felt like home. It also felt very secure. Kitchen was well equipped, stylishly decorated, air-conditioned, the washing machine was very handy, very spacious and light living room, great water pressure and very comfortable beds.

The location was pretty handy, not too far to walk to restaurants, public transport and Taksim square. It was also very easy to find, well signed.

I would definitely recommend staying in Deniz's home.

Upon arrival Deniz greeted us graciously and proceeded to acquaint us to her lovely apartment. The flat was well equipped with all the accouterments to make our stay comfortable and enjoyable. The wifi was reliable, the water was hot, utensils were suitable, laundry facilities were available, and modern windows allowed for a wonderful breeze to blow thru if desired. Deniz even left us with a tasty teas and chocolates, and a nice gift of a Istanbul banner as a remembrance. The neighborhood was equally delightful with many bodega shops and eateries to choose from, and very friendly neighbors. We enjoyed our stay immensely!

I booked Deniz's apartment for my family of 4 people who will come to join my wedding party from Kirghizistan. I can truly say that this was my TOP Airbnb experience. The apartment was very well located, only steps away from public transportation, surrounded by local neighborhood with cheap bakeries, coffee shops, cafes, pizza houses. Deniz took great care of my family, very kind and super attentive. She totally deserves her superhost badge. From now on this will be our first spot in Istanbul.

description:
*Please contact me for short-term stays*
Large 2-bedroom flat with unique decoration in lovely neighbourhood Moda and trendy Bahariye.
It's a peaceful, bright, stylish and recently renovated flat with large windows, a balcony, 2 bedrooms with 2 double beds.
Ideal for solo travellers or 2-4 friends.
Available for short or long terms. Please contact me.
*Not suitable for families with young children*
10mins of walk from the ferry port, subway and bus stations, 15mins from Metrobus.

reviews.text: I can't praise this stay highly enough. Gokce is an amazing host: friendly, helpful, proactive and fast to answer. The apartment is a gem right in the middle of everything in Kadıköy, smoke free and fully equipped with fast internet, fans plus a superb (vegan) kitchen, a nice bathroom and a Totoro cameo. It's even bigger than the pictures suggest! Step outside and you're right in the zone: restaurants, bars and much more within seconds (Marul, SoliBar, Korkmaz Büfe, Uzunçayır Pilavcısı, Çiya Sofrası, to name a few). For BJJ, check out the amazing Inferno Jiu Jitsu; for weightlifting, Hornets Gym. Everything within walking distance! On the street side there's some nightlife and the occasional seagull chorus (always something going on, love it), but the bedroom stays quiet. I'll definitely come again, really happy with this stay. Teşekkürler, sevgili Gokce!

This was just a brilliant stay!
First of all I was lucky to meet Gökçe in person, she is such welcoming and friendly host.
I immediately felt home in her flat which looks exactly the same as the pictures show. She's good a really good and stylish taste in furniture with love to the details. The flat was very clean, so really not the slightest thing to complain about.
The apartment is located in the heart of Kadiköy which in my opinion is the best neighbourhood I know of İstanbul. The area is vivid and lively with tons of options for food and drinks, awesome cafés, bars and restaurant in walking distance. Although streets are busy the bedroom faces the quiet and green courtyard, so you'll have a good and quiet sleep.
From Kadıköy you can easily reach all other parts of this fabulous town and I really recommend the ferry rides.
All in all it was great stay at Gökçe's home and honestly I'm already thinking of when to revisit :-)

Gokce was a great host! Responded very quickly, and was very accommodating to my needs/requests. Check-in instructions were super detailed and helpful.
The apartment was very clean and stylish, a kitchen with all the items you’d need and I could not have asked for a better location. Overall a wonderful place and everything in the apartment is way way better than the pictures so I was surprised when I entered the place. I would definitely recommend.

Perfect location. Clean, spacious and sweet place. The pictures are accurate. The Wi-Fi was strong. Easy check-in & check-out. Gokce was reachable, helpful, responsive. I definitely would like to stay again. Thanks!

Gokce’s place is amazing. it’s in the best neighborhood where it’s very close to the restaurants and nightlife in kadikoy but the bedrooms were still in the quiet side so you can sleep in. The apartment is clean and perfectly furnished and we didn’t need to buy a single thing. It’s made to be lived in and fully equipped and spacious. It gets lots of sunlight and the value for money is the most amazing of any place on airbnb. In the winter it was very insulating so we didn’t need to turn the hearer on. Gokce was very kind and responsive when we needed help.

description: Apartment in wooden house for a crowded group of friends/family >10 persons! Centrally located, just steps from Istiklal in Taksim/Pera. Comfortable, clean, gorgeous. 3double bedrooms, 2 lounges, 2kitchens, 3bathrooms. Ground and basement floors + 2nd&3rd Floor. Free WiFi

reviews.text:
The location is great, within a walking distance to bus and metro station, galata tower, istiklal street and taksim square. Taxis are also everywhere if you stay here. Plenty of mini market nearby for groceries shopping.
The house is equipped with fully functional kitchen, bedrooms are so comfy. Loved the hardwood flooring on each floor.
Loved the personal touch decorated by the host.

we stayed at Miko's for a week. it was a nice stay and we really felt like living as local people in Istanbul.
