The house is located not so far from Istiqlal avenue, about 5 minutes walking and you can easily find anything there, like: fashion shops, souvenir shops? ice cream, cafes, restaurant, etc. We rent an entire house, it comes with a double bedroom, a single bedroom, a bathroom and a kitchen at first floor, then at second floor is 2 double bedroom and a big bathroom , while third floor is an attic where you can find a dining table, a kitchen, a small single bed and couch for relaxing.e if you visit during summer there is no aircon or fan provided, however you can sleep with the window open. its quite nice and cooling, but there will be some noises. there is no washing machine but miko help us with the laundry everytime we need. nearby about 1 minutr walking you will find small shops where you can buy drinks, snack and fruits. all in all it was a nice stay at miko's.

Our group of ten greatly enjoyed our stay at Miko and his wife’s place. It was a fun space in a great location very near Istikal street with so many fun places to eat and shop. They were very helpful and quick to respond to questions including arranging transport from the airport. The top floor was a great open area for hanging out, but it did get quite warm when the weather was hot. We would return again for sure.

We had a wonderful stay with 7 people in Miko's apartment. The location was perfect, with nice restaurants and shopping streets around the corner. Miko arranged for a car to pick us up from the two airports on which we arrived and bring us to the apartment.

The apartment has all basic needs but the upper living space was a bit small for some of us, not everybody could stand up straight. However we had a lot of fun in this room as we played card games and had breakfast together. With some minor adjustments, the apartment could be made more comfortable, for example lights and some furniture need fixing.

Every day we took trips in Istanbul, we either walked, took the tram or took the ferry. The apartment is situated at a very good location to get to know Istanbul. Overall, our stay was very pleasant.

We are happy that found your house! Awesome view on the roof, very cozy rooms and great location!!!
Very clean house in the quite district but near center!
Miko is a good owner, he gave us full information about the house and nearby points, it was very useful!

description: Two Bedroom Suite of Pera Residence are glorious and have an area of 150 sqm.Tastefully decorated with modern furniture,Pera Residence 's Two Bedroom Suites have a marvellous design, relaxing atmosphere.

reviews.text: I had a wonderful week here and spent six nights in this apartment. It is very, very pleasant. The apartment is modern, clean, highly comfortable, and quiet—even though it's located in a trendy, bustling area with plenty of restaurants and 24-hour activity. You don't hear a thing inside the apartment. The location is excellent, with easy access to everything, major sights, and public transportation. The kitchen doesn't have many amenities. In fact, it has almost no utensils at all if you plan on cooking. However, you have great access to restaurants and markets in the area. If you want a quick snack or prefer to eat out, it’s very easily accessible. I will definitely stay there again when I return to Istanbul

We had a wonderful time. The apartment is huge and in a really great location. I loved the big living room, bedrooms and bathrooms and tons of storage space. I wish the owner posted more photos because the current pictures don’t do it justice.
My only complaint was that the floors were a bit dirty when we arrived and dishes were still in the dishwasher. The owner didn’t initially provide any of the essentials (paper towels, soup, toilet paper) but was very responsive when we requested it. I would also add a bit more decorations to make the place feel a bit more homey.
We really enjoyed our stay and would recommend this to our friends!

Great location, close to Takseem street nice bars and restaurant in the neighborhood, you dont have to worry about noise or anything bedrooms are sounds proof
Clean place , staff extremely helpful

This place was extremely well located, the place was much bigger than it looked in the picture, everything was very clean and while the street was pretty noisy till two or 3 o’clock in the morning, do it back into the bedroom and close the door I didn’t hear a thing. We slept very well. I would say again.

With every place there are good and bad things.
We'll start with the good. The service was great and very accommodating. They answered messages promptly and and issue that came up, they were there in no time to fix it. The location was incredible. Access to many attractions and restaurants. They place is big and easily accessible with an elevator.
However there were issues. The location. As centralized as it is, you need to be prepared for the amount of noise that surrounds the apartment. High volume traffic - cars and tourist. Loud bars that stay open until 4:00 am. If you plan is to party in the city, then it's no issue. The second bedroom's bed isn't as big as you would think. It might be a full size, but that would be generous. Pillows were bad. Not much as far as cooking utensils
Also, the place has seen better days. Things were breaking left and right. We stopped advising the reception about those issues. To be clear, the ones we did tell reception, they fixed immediately.

description: The flat is in BAŞAKŞEHİR. It is the most safety and luxery compound in the center. And it has 3 bedrooms and 1 saloon,2 bathrooms.8 people can stay in the apartment.it is in a wellness place which has 7/24 security, pool,gym,playground for kids,indoor and outdoor car parking place and more.Only 15 minutes far away by car from Istanbul Airport and MALL OF İSTANBUL .5 minutes to Istanbul City hospitals, metro stations and E-5 highway.It ll be your best apartment in Istanbul. MORE THAN EVERYTHİNG

reviews.text:
Nice and clean place.
Perfect for a family with great view.
Compound has good security and a parking lot for your car.
Would recommend for long stays.

This was a great place to be. The host was very friendly, great at communicating, and great at welcoming us as guests. He also helped us with some very useful information about our stay there. For the place solely, it is in a good area that gives you more of a local experience of Istanbul. The very touristy areas are a bit far and could be a long drive so you may need taxi or regular commute via the metro at times. But overall I enjoyed my stay at this place! Thank you for this experience! :)

Excellent and big flat with a stunning view. Peaceful condo in the new house, balcony. But have some disadvantages:
- the kitchen is not clean
- smell from canalization (it's the main issue at all)
Nice place

Nurullah the great landlord!! It was a pleasure to stay at his apartment!
Very customer-oriented, polite and flexible!
I it was possible I would stay there for a long time :)

description: This unique place has its own style.

reviews.text: The area and location are great, with a beautiful view of the Bosporus Strait from the window, just as shown in the photos. The amenities are exactly as described in the listing. Check-in was quick and easy. The only minor downside was a bad smell in the stairwell leading up to the apartment, but this is outside the host’s control and doesn’t affect your experience once you’re inside the apartment

We selected this apartment for the view, and we were not disappointed. Even better than imagined. You will need to work for the view by climbing 5 flights of a stone, spiral staircase, but it's worth it, and good for you. Kadir met us at the apartment and we didn't have to carry any of our bags up the stairs. We stayed for 11 days and really enjoyed the charming and peaceful neighborhood in a great location.
The apartment was clean and everything worked well, including plumbing and the internet. We appreciated the big dispenser of bottled water and the bottle of wine. We especially enjoyed a few meals of charcuterie from the Spice Market at the large dining table. There were plenty of dishes and glassware, and a large cutting board for the charcuterie and fruit from the nearby fruit market.
The apartment is perfect for 2 people. We were able to put our suitcases away in a closet and hang clothes and use drawers in a separate closet. We would definitely stay here again.

First of all: great location, great view, great WiFi. There are a few things that could be improved. The shower was not draining quickly enough, there were no shower accessories such as soap or shampoo, the bed is awfully small, and the air con struggles to keep up with 33C+ degree days, especially with this apartment being on the 5th floor. Additionally (while this was no issue for us), this apartment is up 5 flights of stairs, so just be advised. Overall good communication, and they brought us a fan when I asked because of how hot the apartment was, which was nice.

We absolutely loved our 1 month stay in the apartment! Especially the view from the living room was so beautiful on the mosque and to the Bosporous - even better than in the pictures! :)
The apartment was modern, clean, well-equipped, with beautiful design, and we really felt like home. The WiFi worked good and was stable during whole stay.
Kadir and Ahmed, the co-host, were so friendly, welcoming, and always helped us when we needed something.
The location was also perfect; very close to a lot of nice cafes, restaurants, and bars, as well as close to ferry and bus/tram stations.
We also would recommend the apartment and hope to come back soon! :)

so Kadirs place was great! The view was amazing as described, the flat was clean and well maintained, bed was super comfortable, but I can not imagine two people sleeping on it, the sofa is super comfortable and you could have a great sleep in it.
Being on the 5th floor is a little challenging especially if you have health issues, but you get that amazing view!
okay the biggest negative for me or for anyone who has a car is Parking!! yes there is an other park close to the apartment but it's always full! I really struggled with parking there and it was stressful and especially dealing with the parking attendants, they are like Mafia, I ended up paying 20 dollars per night to park the car.
if you do not have a car, then this apartment is amazing and the restaurants and cafes surrounding it are also great.
it would be nice if there was a nespresso machine :)
great stay and we will back for sure but without a car

description: Our apartment is in the center of Kadıköy's new entertainment and shopping venues, within walking distance to the Marmaray and high-speed train station, close to all means of transport, the Altıyol bull and ferry port, the historical Kadıköy bazaar. 20 m2 including unlimited wi-fi, furnished, shower/wc, air conditioning, Led TV, kettle, mini fridge. There is no elevator in our building. Kitchenette is in tje common area.ınternet speed 100mpbs

reviews.text: Gökalp's place was a very nice experience. The location is one of the best, just a 10 minute walk from both the Kadıköy ferry port and the Marmaray/Metro station at Ayrılık Çesmesi. The room was very cozy, but with very low ceilings which were a stretch for me at 178cm. The room was clean, had a window and air conditioning and a kettle but no ensuite kitchen (as described in the post). The bathroom was quite small. For a stay of up to a month I would recommend this room, but a little longer might be too much for the space. Gökalp and his partner were excellent, responsive, and helped me every step of the way during my stay. Overall highly recommend this space, especially for shorter term stays.

This room is exactly as it seems. I stayed for one month while working remotely, and I was very happy. There's a bunch of nice cafes/bars/restuarants nearby, and it's easy to get around the rest of Istanbul. Getting here from either airport is easy. Check-in was easy, and the host was always easy to reach via WhatsApp. Cleaning of the room and changing of sheets/towels is available for a very reasonable fee, there's also a washing machine etc if you want to do it yourself. It basically feels like a hotel but with no reception. The toilet was clean, there's A/C. Maybe the only thing I'd advise to be careful of is if you have any mobility issues, the room is up some quite steep stairs—no problem for most however.

I stayed here just over a month and the room definitely met my expectations. The monthly rate was a great deal and provided a clean, comfortable, safe place to sleep and relax. Any questions I had were addressed very quickly and communication with the manager was great.
The unit’s location in Yeldeğirmeni, Kadıköy is a beautiful part of town! The ferry, metro, mall and main part of Kadıköy are all very short walks away and there are excellent cafes and restaurants just out the door. A month wasn’t even long enough to try all the nearby food that I wanted to. All the nightlife in Kadıköy and Moda is only a 10 minute walk but this street stays relatively quiet at night, which is what I prefer.
For someone wanting to spend a lot of time in the room or preferring to do a lot of their own cooking, the low attic ceiling and separate/communal kitchen might make the place un-ideal for longer stays; however, these were not an issue for me personally.
I hope to return to Istanbul, and I’d be happy to stay in this place again when I do.

I have spent two months in this room, which is essentially a hotel room. If you don't require much, it would be perfect for you. The location is excellent, as it is very close to the ferry port. This allows you to easily explore the vast city by hopping on a boat. You can also take a stroll through Kadikoy and explore this vibrant neighborhood on foot. There are many fantastic restaurants and bars, making it a lively area.
Gokalp was very responsive and helpful in addressing any issues that arose.
The only aspect that left me disappointed was the Wifi. It was advertised as "100mbps" in the description, but as a remote worker, I need strong Wifi for my job. Unfortunately, I was not able to work in this room due to the weak and unreliable Wifi. I had to find coworking spaces instead. It seems that the connection is 100mbps at the main entrance, but the room is located on the upper floors.

Gokalp is a great host, the location is great and its clean. I would not recommend the Room in the Roof if there other ones are available. Its only good for sleeping and showering. Since its really small and the ceiling is low.

description: Your cozy escape with a private terrace in Cihangir: Nestled in the heart of Beyoglu, Cihangir, our delightful studio invites you to experience the center of urban charm. Our one-bedroom studio, accommodating 2 guests with 1 bed and 1 bath, this charming apartment boasts a plenty of amenities, ensuring a comfortable and stylish stay in the dynamic heart of Istanbul.

reviews.text:
Hosts were very helpful and extremely quick to respond. The location was amazing - almost all sights, ferry stations and bus stations were within a walking distance. The place was extremely clean but the large patio was the real star of the show.
We knew beforehand that the studio would be small but it still ended up being a bit smaller than what we gathered from pictures but we didn’t mind.
The one and only downside of this accommodation was the noise. There are a few bars nearby that played very loud music every night till morning even though it wasn’t weekend so we couldn’t sleep properly or at all for most of our week-long stay. That’s why I’d say that if you’re a light sleeper then opt for a different accommodation but if the noise doesn’t bother you or disrupt your sleep, then this is one of the best places you could stay at.

Stayed at that amazing apartment for a few days. All the positive reviews from others I can agree.
Very comfortable studio apartment, with a really nice terrace. The kitchen and the whole flat is very clean and you have everything you need for a stay.
Located in the center and a very nice neighborhood, can be loud sometimes at night which was totally fine.
The Check in and Check Out was really easy, the hosts are also very helpful if you have questions regarding restaurants…
I would definitely recommend this place! Thank you :)

Had a very comfortable stay at this apartment. It was extremely clean and free of clutter, and the shower and terrace were lovely. The only downside is that there is a club near the apartment that plays loud music until early in the morning. I usually am not kept awake by background noise but this was louder than I had expected. However, it’s not in the host’s control, so just bring earplugs! Thank you for a wonderful stay :)

The studio is just like described, small and cute. Very clean! I’m completely satisfied with my stay.
Although it’s very noisy at night due to lots of bars around.
The building has no elevator and there is no washing machine in the apartment.
The host was very responsive and check in went smoothly.

Great place for short stays. It is centrally located within walking distance to Taksim Square and thus it's easy to reach from both airports by public transport, and the street it is in is pretty with a shop next door. The place was tiny (duh, it's a studio) but it had all the necessary amenities in surplus. There wasn't any issues regarding cleanliness of the place. Terrace is a nice edition but it might get chilly at nights. Missy and Nesli are great hosts, but I did not meet them personally. The only downside I could think of is that there is a nightclub across the street and they tend to get loud at nights but it's nothing an earplug won't solve. I would recommend it for short stays and the price is pretty reasonable for how expensive Istanbul can get.

description:
Spacious elegant apartment in a wooden house of Old Istanbul. Centrally located, just steps from the main Istiklal Street. Comfortable, clean. Two double rooms, three living rooms, two bathrooms; three floors.Free WiFi

PLEASE READ carefully our COVID-19 UPDATE. Special arrangements for Pandemia of Corona. WE CARE YOUR SAFETY

reviews.text:
My family of 10 and I stayed at mikos home for 5 days. Him and his wife are very kind and hospitable however with that being said the home and our stay were not the best. To start, the home is very outdated and dirty, the baseboards and corners all have dirt and old garbage. The two washrooms, upstairs and downstairs smell of sewage, the downstairs washroom is quite close to the living room area so the sewage and old urine smell seeps into the living area. The WiFi did not work the entire time, even after miko reset it for us, my family and I had to purchase data SIM cards and tether it to one another.
The stairs are very difficult to maneuver for any middle aged or elderly people and the balcony is extremely difficult and scary to access. The bed in the living room has a large arm bar in the middle and all of the mattresses were extremely uncomfortable, you could feel the springs as you moved. There was also no AC and the house was very hot, even after miko brought us one fan. We had to leave the windows open at night due to the heat and the street noise made it very difficult to sleep.
You are asked not to wear shoes in the house, however I would recommend bringing your own slippers as the ones provided are quite dirty and a few of my family members had splinters on their feet from walking on the hardwood floor barefoot.
After discussing some concerns with miko, he apologized and also mentioned that I had originally booked the air bnb for 8 people but there was 10 people staying there (which was only for one night, as they left early) and that he wouldn’t charge me the extra cleaning fee which was kind of him. Although the house was not clean itself when I checked in.
The location however was very good and was walking distance from shops and restaurants. If you are looking for a semi affordable stay and for somewhere to lay your head at night then I would recommend mikos place. However for a large family who wanted to spend time together and cook and gather around in the home, it was not ideal.

Miko and his wife were extremely friendly and provided a lot of helpful information before our arrival. Though we decided to do most of our exploring independently they offered a wide range of options for organising excisions and trips.

The house had everything we needed for a short stay, we were able to cook etc. It was also extremely spacious and nicely furnished. The house was perfect for our large group and amazing value for money, ideally located for the main sights of Istanbul and for getting around the the city. It was also presented clean and with everything in working order.

The roof terrace was an amazing addition with views over the city. I would highly recommend anyone to stay with Miko.

House was old but descent! The hosts were nice and uncomplicated! Location was good beacause you could reach all the main sights easily with a taxi! But the house is really not big enough to host 15 people according to the available beds! We were 8 guys and already one had to sleep on a couch. But i think for 8 people it is ok! At the first moment we were a little bit disapointed by the roof top! It looked way better and bigger on the pictures and you are not allowed to go up during the night because of the neighbours. Additionally you can just reach it trough a very very small window. But if you are uncomplicated and just want to use it for a having a drink watching the sunset it's alright! And the view is a reward it is really nice and we enjoyed it sitting up there on the small rooftop!
Alltogether it was a nice stay and if you are not looking for luxury but for a well located place to stay for a weekend trip, i can recommend this place!

The accomodation is perfectly located for exploring Istanbul. It is situated in a quiet residential area, but just on the other side of the main road there is a lively quarter with plenty of nice restaurants, cafés, bars and shops. You can venture out on foot for sightseeing or use the public transport connections nearby. I can strongly recommend the accomodation as such, too. It was perfect for us as a family with a kid of 1.5 years, as it has several rooms and a baby bed was also offered. The house also has a nice old flair and is quite special in that way. The host and is family are friendly and very helpful. A good choice!

Miko and his wife were very gracious hosts. They live next door to the house, and were very friendly and willing to help with whatever my group needed. The house was charming and a perfect fit for my large group of friends, with so many bedrooms to accommodate us all. The one drawback was that there is no AC or fans, so our stay in August was rather hot, but we slept fine with open windows and the breeze. I would highly recommend this house for a group of laid-back travelers.

reviews.text:
Great location. Although our taxi driver struggled to find the drop-off point, the receptionist kindly came to find us and walked us to the accommodation. The elevator was convenient, and the property is well located near restaurants and the lively Istiklal Street. The space itself was well kept, beautiful, and worked well for our family of three adults.
A few issues to note, some of which were outside the host’s control and handled as proactively as possible. There was a 4–6 hour power outage one evening. While not the host’s fault, having backup lighting such as emergency lights or candles would have been helpful, especially as the outage continued into the night. The TV screen also displayed a green tint toward the end of our stay.
Toilet paper was quite limited for three guests and, after requesting it twice, we ended up purchasing our own. Hot water was good but did not last long enough for three consecutive showers, possibly due to winter conditions.

We had to extend our stay in Istanbul due to testing positive for Covid so were happy to find a spot in Taksim on such short notice! We found Sina to be a bit rude at check in and his constant interrogative style questioning throughout our stay made us uncomfortable. The apartment is spacious and the kitchen was a great addition for spending a week cooped up recuperating. The cleanliness of the apartment was subpar though. We kept finding hair that was not ours everywhere which was absolutely disgusting. Would definitely recommend for it's location and though Sina wasn't our cup of tea, others may feel more comfortable around him. Lastly, the listing said guests have access to laundry services but when we asked they were suddenly no longer available.
Great stay at Ferid’s place! Clean, comfortable, and well located. Ferid was very friendly, responsive, and helpful. Highly recommended.

Staying at this apartment for the second time was an absolute delight!
The apartment is absolutely stunning - spacious, beautifully decorated, and spotlessly clean. Located in the heart of Taksim, it offers the best possible location for exploring Istanbul. Everything you could need - restaurants, shops, and attractions - is just a few steps away, making it incredibly convenient.
Ferid is an exceptional host, always kind, professional, and attentive to every detail to ensure a perfect stay. It truly felt like a home away from home, and I cannot recommend it highly enough. Thank you, Ferid, for another unforgettable experience - I will certainly be back!
Everything was perfect, the place is super clean pretty spacious and stylish. Communication is easy. Location is amazing.

description:
Discover Istanbul from our charming apartment. A short walk from Taksim Square, the city's bustling hub, and the chic shopping streets of Nişantaşı, it's perfectly positioned for an authentic experience. Relish the contrast of vibrant city life and the tranquility of nearby MaçkaPark.

Crafted for comfort, our space invites you to immerse in Istanbul's rich culture and cosmopolitan charm. Your unforgettable journey begins here

Note: For comfortable airport transfer service please contact me.

reviews.text: Zelal is sooo gracious and kind, the best host one can hope for! We booked same day after we had to change our plans because of bad experience at another listing and Zelal was so helpful in getting us checked in as soon as possible as her other guests were leaving the same day. The apartment is up one flight of well-lit stairs. The whole apartment was so clean and cozy. Bathroom is neat and includes a washer (no dryer but plenty of places to hang clothes to dry including on the balcony). Both bedrooms were so nice, quiet and peaceful at night and full of daylight in the day time. Entrance to the second bedroom goes through the first bedroom as is shown in the pictures. Location is in a nice neighborhood close to Taksim with plenty of public transport close by. The apartment is located one street away from the main road and is downhill from a steep road. Would love to stay again in the future if we ever visit Istanbul again!!

The apartment met all our needs and expectations while traveling with our young baby in Istanbul. Everything was as described, in fact some of the pictures are missing some of the more recent minor improvements. The flat was spacious, clean, clutter free and well organised. It's on a safe and quiet street down a slope from the main street with abundance of public transport options and stores within short walking distance. Zuzu and her sister were very responsive and helpful from the time of our booking until our departure. The flat is one level above ground and the lift is not working, however stairs are not excessive, especially in Istanbul standards. We would be very happy to return for our next stays in Istanbul.

Zelal’s place was very cozy and super clean which I loved (bed sheets were spotless & smelled really nice), the house is a 3 minute walk from bus station and about 7 mns from the metro (with supermarket right under). Took me about 30 minutes to get to most attractions which was fine.
Place looks just like the pictures and the check-in process was smooth, it’s on the first floor but the elevator doesn’t work, so it was okay to carry the bags upstairs.
Even though it’s not on a main street it does get a bit noisy in the living room due to the windows not being fully sound proof, at night it’s alright though and in the bedrooms it’s quiet.
Only faced an issue with a broken door knob that led us to be trapped inside a room but Zelal was quick to answer and offered help so it got sorted shortly after and she did say she’ll get it fixed for the next renter.
Overall Zelal was very quick to respond and very helpful, I’d definitely love to stay at her house again.

Very clean space. As a host I could see the home is renovated very well in the bathroom but the living and kitchen area are not renovated. Also no tv, no microwave, no fans, no AC, slow WiFi, loud neighbors,.The bedroom faces into other apartment windows who can see directly inside the bedroom. For privacy I wanted to close bedroom curtains but because of heat in the room, had to keep windows open. From bedroom I could hear neighbors talking, neighbors coughing, neighbors televisions, and cats crying and fighting until 2 am. The first morning the host arrives at the door knocking loudly waking me up without any notice! No message to me on Airbnb. She asked to enter to clean the Airbnb again which was very strange. Biggest issue- WiFi was slow about 0.5 to 3 mbps so I could not work. Host said she called but could not fix. And then says if I leave she’ll give no refunds. I contact Airbnb, they cancel booking in the evening. Host agrees to meet at 2pm next day for check out . The second morning another surprise arrival. knocks on the door waking me up AGAIN when I am trying to recover from surgery without any prior notice or message. Said she wanted to check the WiFi even though booking was already cancelled by Airbnb. WiFi was little faster but still slow- 15/20 mbps so slower than even my cell phone. For such a small space I think it should be priced $25 euro/ day maximum. Thankfully Airbnb helped me to move to a home with 95 mbps and I am very grateful. The host was very very kind so I wished the home was better equipped, more quiet and had more privacy.

Zelai's place was as described, the bed was very comfortable and shower pressure was very good, lounge and kitchen well designed and facilitated with all that you need.
The place is very clean and well maintained, she takes pride in being a host. Aside from her apartment I found Zelai to be a very warm and kind person, she recommended some great places to eat and see.

description:
Welcome to Istanbul! İstanbul’a hoş geldiniz! :)

I would be more than happy to host you in my fully renovated apartment. You will be located in a super cosy, central apartment in the heart of the city: just a few steps away from the tramway and metro station, 5 minutes walk to the ferry port and to GalataPort, 7 minutes walk to Taksim square…

reviews.text: This apartment was our best choice and we enjoyed so much to stay in Yaz’s place. Good position, close to all main attractions. We walked everywhere we want and used ferry from karaokoy station situated just 15 min walk from apartment. The place was very clean and cozy, with beautiful terrace and everything you need for comfortable staying. Yaz is the best host ever, always available helpful and friendly, the communication was fast, easy and enjoyable. We really recommend this apartment If you want to experience real Istanbul vibe instead of being just tourist.

A clean & beautiful home in a great location, with walking distance from Taksim, Galataport & Kabatash (including pubic transport)... There are some stairs in the street to reach the home that can be considered for older travers. Yaz (the host) is really responsive and supporter!
The host guide on her profile has a lot of excellent recommendations on the city attractions, cafes, restaurants &... Don't miss having a look!

As it turned out, I was Yaz's first tenant, and she was my first AirBnb host in Istanbul, since before I had to come to the city only to visit my relatives. And to share my impressions, I was very satisfied with Yaz's apartment!

Foremost, it is very well located in relation to the Galata Port promenade and Karaköy neighborhood, and you can easily reach the main city attraction with the T1 streetcar. The apartment itself was very clean, cozy and equipped with all the necessary amenities. In addition to that, there was a beautiful view of a small garden with tangerine trees outside the window. Personally, I preferred the Yaz's apartment for this reason compared to many apartments in Istanbul that have a view of houses across the street or noisy streets, especially in an area like Beyoğlu.

In conclusion, I am willing to recommend this AirBnb to any traveler or vacationing couple, as it would be the best choice in terms of location, coziness and price!

Yaz has a beautiful place that we enjoyed while in Istanbul. Walkable to almost everywhere and quiet neighbourhood which allowed us to sleep well after a long day outside. Her home is really home away from home with lovely little things and fully stocked for your stay. What makes all of it worth it is that she is a lovely host and is super helpful. I would love to come back to her home.

We were happy to stay here for our vacation. Yaz was helpful and friendly, met us even though we were late, and left her city guide and flat instructions. The apartment is sunny and cozy and has everything you need. Cats are coming to visit you on a private terrace with tangerine trees :)
Great connection to the attractions: many of them are within the walking distance, and others you can easily reach by transport. The apartment is not on a tourist street, which is a huge plus. If you're allergic to climbing stairs, it could be a problem, but we enjoyed this vacation gym. We will definitely look forward to staying at Yaz's apartment next time!

description: A clean, bright and spacious flat in the middle of the districts of Eyup and Gaziosmanpasa, which is at a short ride to historical and touristic attractions. The building has no elevator, however it is only a three-storey building and the flat is at the third floor with easy stairs. The flat offers all the facilities for a comfortable stay in a building populated by families.

reviews.text:
We liked the place. It is exactly as described. I was not disappointed in any way. The apartment is comfortable, clean, has all u need and it feels homey :)
We enjoyed the neighborhood also. Nearby u can find several minimarkets, buy tasty Turkish deserts, warm super fresh bread and I would recommend to experience this Sundays street market with very convinient/cheap prices. From this neighborhood u can reach historical part of the city taking direct buses.
Kemal is a really nice host! He is prompt in responding our questions. The check in was smooth. Kemal provided us with transfer from airport for very affordable price even that it was late at night. He also was so nice that took our very heavy luggage from car to apartment.
I would not hesitate to stay here again and to recommend this place to my friends!

Large apartment with everything you need. Excellent host who was always responsive and willing to help, though no help was needed since everything was good with the apartment during our 35 day stay. Solid food and grocery delivery options on Yemeksepeti. A nice and large balcony. Two bedrooms and all the couches you could ever need. Fast Wi-Fi and cellular data works well too (both eSIM and physical SIM). Dishwasher and clothes dryer, which are rare amenities in a country like Turkey. The neighborhood (Gaziosmanpaşa) is a working class neighborhood but it is completely safe (practically no tourists in this area of Istanbul so you'll also get to avoid scams and overpricing, unlike in neighborhoods like Sultanahmet). Very close to Balat via 10 minute walk and ~15-20 minutes direct bus and fairly close to Taksim and Sultanahmet / Eminönü (10 minute walk + ~30 minute direct bus). This was the best choice for a high value large apartment during our May-June 2023 stay in Istanbul.

The flat is very comfortable and clear. It's the same, like on photos. Host is friendly and always ready to help. He showed us our area in first day and later gave us a lot of usefull information about city.
We definitely enjoyed staing there and can recommend everybody to use this flat

Kemal was very helpful not only with the arrival but also during my stay. He offered quick help with everything i needed at any time. The place is very comfortable and clean. The kitchen and the bathroom are full equipped with all you need. Thank you very much Kemal. I definitely recommend it for other guests!

Kemal is an awesome host, very quick to respond and always happy to help. The apartment is nice and clean just like in the photos. The neighbourhood is quiet and safe just a little bit far away from night life but apart from that our stay has been amazing. Thank you Kemal :)

reviews.text:

Overall, we had a positive stay and really appreciated the host’s kindness and responsiveness.

Hello, everyone! I definitely recommend this stay, everything was clean and just as described on Airbnb.

Easy self check-in, clean, amazing view. The area looks like business area. The apartment is new, building well secured 👍👍👍

Adem was a great host, he was always responding in time and providing anything we need. The space was fabulous, very well designed and only 2 mins away from the subway station. description:
Our Suite is modern and carefully designed. This Suite has 1 Living room ,1 Bedroom has a double bed, 42 inch smart TV, private Balcony ,bathroom , small kitchen with a minifridge & kitchen supplies.
Our room is on the 3th floor and is the only room on the floor. There is a 24/7 camera and security system. The building's exterior door is specially coded and protected. OurSuite is designed to accommodate 2 people. there are also at the building washing machine and dryer machine for the clothes .

reviews.text:
The suite truly felt like home — clean, cozy, and comfortable, located in a peaceful neighborhood just a short walk from Ortaköy Maidan. Everything was exactly as described.
Parva and the staff were responsive, polite, and genuinely hospitable. They offered cleaning and laundry services and made sure everything was taken care of with kindness and professionalism.
I’ve visited this city several times, and this is the only place I can recommend without hesitation. I’ll definitely stay here again in the future.

We had a great time at Cansu's place.
The place was very cozy, modern and clean.
It had air conditioning and heater in each room, which made the place comfortable for us.
Cansu put some extra attention to decoration with nice plants, flower pots and special pictures on the wall.
The bathroom was perfectly clean and all items felt solid. There were no unpleasant smell as experienced sometimes in other places in Istanbul.
Nothing was missing in the amenities, from powerful hairdryer, high quality TV, washing machine (with enough powder), drier, refined soap & shampoo.
I should perhaps have started by saying how friendly and helpful Cansu and her partner were with us. We had immediate answer to any request. She even helped us with medicines when one of us became sick, although we just asked for doctor.
Cansu is the perfect example of SuperHost.
Thanks again for our smooth and enjoyable experience in Istanbul.
Highly recommended ! Best experience in Istanbul among 10+ trips.

The location is excellent: Ortakoy is a lively neighborhood right on the Bosporus - with many basic services plus shops, bars, and restaurants - from which you can easily reach several other parts of the city, also by ferry. The cozy suite has everything you need for a short or long stay. I found the place perfectly clean, and the room was additionally cleaned mid-stay (I didn't expect it, but I really appreciated it). The host is extremely patient and helpful. So, excellent value for money, especially compared to the prices of the surrounding hotels. I definitely enjoyed the time I spent there and certainly recommend it!

This unit is very clean and comfortable. It is easily accessible with public transit (Bus, ferry boat, taxis, ...) with lots to do nearby. What especially stood out was Cansu's outstanding hospitality. She was super flexible and responsive. Couldn't ask for more. Our unit was on the third floor (The US 4th floor!). This was not a problem for us as we were planning on walking a number of miles every day anyway. Cansu offered to have someone carry our suitcases upstairs. All in all, a wonderful stay. A definite high-ranking candidate location for future visits.

description:
We have specially designed this apartment for our guests who prefer a luxurious stay in a very central location. It is just 1 minute to famous Galata Tower and Istiklal Avenue where you can find the best restaurants, bars, night clubs, cinemas, pubs, gift shops, shopping centers of Istanbul.

This spacious apartment could provide accommodation up to 6 guests. The apartment has two double bedrooms with queen size beds and a single bedroom with two single beds.

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at this apartment in Istanbul! Everything was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully equipped. The location was excellent, with easy access to restaurants, cafés, public transportation, and many of the city’s top attractions.
The highlight of our stay was the incredible view from the kitchen. Seeing the beautiful Galata Tower right from the kitchen window made every morning and evening feel special. It was truly one of the most memorable parts of our experience.
The host was friendly, responsive, and always willing to help. We felt very welcome throughout our stay and would happily choose this apartment again on our next trip to Istanbul. Highly recommended!

Pros — communicate host with easy check in, great location with lots to do and see, close to most things and accessible. All three bedrooms had their own air conditioning unit which was great. The area is a bit hilly so would not recommend for anyone with mobility issues. Everything is open to late, but fortunately there were no noise issues when sleeping. Area is quite touristy so as expected, things cost 2-3x more in this area and there are a lot of people trying to rip off tourists
Cons — water heater broke down on second night and host came by to fix it and it was fixed in a few minutes. broke again a few nights later and this time it took hours and hours to fix it again. sounds like host knew the water heater was old and had issues so ideally should have addressed the heater issue before renting the place out.
both inside and outside the place in the hallway with stairs (no elevator) are relatively poorly lit.

We had a great stay at this apartment. It matched the pictures exactly and was very clean. Great views of the Galata Tower. Check-in and communication was easy. Wifi was fast, water pressure was excellent. Heating worked well. The beds were comfortable. Some noise and music from the streets is unavoidable in this area but it did not bother us. There is relatively little common space in which to congregate except for a dining table with chairs and the stools in the kitchen, but we found this sufficient. Highly recommended.

The location was very convenient. The restaurant downstairs had wonderful food/coffee. The host didn’t greet us instead she send someone to open the door.
Pros-location, description of the apartment, great AC in all rooms
Cons-there should be check list of how to operate washer/dryer as it is not in English, checkout process as I had to text host where to leave keys as our flight was in middle of the night( I could have asked host each time but we are here for vacation), where to throw trash, very noisy at night (outside traffic, neighbors noise even at 1am, no elevator so you have to take several stairs (something that can be noted incase mobility issues), pest control(there were ants even though we didn’t cook), the street is on a hilly area(not host fault)

Daria was the most unhelpful and unpleasant host we have ever experienced. She refused to provide help with a later check-out despite having no check-ins after us. She also rejected with storing our luggage for a couple of hours. Daria had promised to help with luggage as the place has many stairs and my wife was pregnant, she failed to help.
The place is misrepresented in a few ways. The living room is not a living room, it is the tiniest hall way, which makes it hard to move around as the dining table feels larger than the room itself. The wooden floors are extremely squeaky and loud. We could also hear the neighbours upstairs all the time.
Another misrepresentation is the photos of the TV screens in the bedrooms, they have managed to find the oldest and cheapest screens that require you to navigate using a computer curser, which then plays an audio quality of a speaker used in a cheap toy.
Overall wouldn’t recommend staying with this host.

description: In the most beautiful part of Tarabya, 750m away from the Bosphorus, furnished with classic Osmalı decoration surrounded by high stone walls, 5 rooms 1 living room in each room tv lounge giant screen tv away from the noise, garden enjoyment with nightingale sounds in the city.

reviews.text: The home is in a beautiful location and spacious. The hosts are very helpful and accommodating. They respond to issues very quickly. However the home is still under renovation as the master bedroom sink is not functional. The home can host 10 people comfortably. Overall a great home in a great area art a good price.

Great host , always responsive . Clean place and as advertised. Location is a bit hard if you don’t have a car. All Maintanance issue we had Tayfun was able to sort it out within 12 hours max. Could benefit from a bit of furniture refresher but all in all great host and a nice place, I recommend.
It's was very clean and comfortable house. Just need to upgrade to TV unit.

Positive: quite and nice area for a big group of people who aren't picky.
Negative: Everything is too old and not matching the pictures. One of the chairs at the dining table broke down when a senior guest was sitting on it. we were lucky she was fine. other example is the coffee maker pot with a broken hand. you pick it up and it gets detached. safety hazard.
The outlets are absolutely dangerous for everyone especially kids.
There's a camera inside the house between the second floor bedrooms. It's a big privacy concern for sure.
Nice spacious house for group of people. Good for big families. Great outdoor space and terrace to sit in the evening's . We mostly used rental car, but metro station 10 min walk. Will recommend!

description:
Relax in our recently refurbished, modern rooms decorated in earth-tones. Hard-wood floors, natural light shining through floor-to-ceiling windows offering remarkable views, and fine linens and plush pillows, all enrich the comfort you feel at our apartments.

Choose among rooms that offer stunning views of the Sea of Marmara and across to Asia, or our rooms with the picturesque views of the old city and Sultanahmet district.

reviews.text: The apt was as described. The stairs to it are steep and narrow. Once we did them a few times we were used to them. We are older (60s) and managed just fine. We adored the balcony! such a great view of the Sea of Marmara. We'd pick up an Efes beer and enjoy watching the ships after touring around. All the places you want to see are in very easy walking distance. The Blue mosque, Hagia Sophia, The grand Bazaar. We loved the Archeology museum. Get your museum pass and save some $$. In the neighborhood are some very good and friendly restaurants..A shout out to Bram cafe and hotel. Open early 7 for coffee, a bit later for breakfast. Great vibe and friendly. We had an issue during our stay w the bathroom and it was addressed and fixed right away. The Internet wouldn't work for us and remedies were tried. You can't beat the location. We found that taxis had trouble finding it so we used the Amira hotel as a reference. So it is a plain room, comfortable bed, nice and clean, fabulous balcony

Zeynep's place was in a very central location and it was easy to walk to everything we wanted to see. It is worth checking out the "little Ayasofia" that is only a couple of blocks away. The view from the bedroom was great, and we spent a lot of time at night on the balcony. The AC worked very well and cooled off the place very quickly.
The only thing I would put on the wishlist is some basic teas and coffees for guests who like to have a relaxing morning and drink their coffee in the apartment, kind of like most hotels offer.
Otherwise, this place was worth the money and centrally located and Zeynep was a great host.

Like most reviewers before, we loved this apartment because of the balcony and view, and the hardwood floors. It felt like a real home ideally located for a first visit to Istanbul. The description and photos are entirely accurate and communication was very easy. Air-conditioning and internet worked well. The steps to the top floor were no problem for us, but could be if you struggle with 29 steps. We would gladly return.

We had a great time at Zeynep's place. the location is excellent, very close to all the major attractions and to good bars and restaurants. Communication was very good and very helpful with good recommendations. The flat was very clean and exactly as advertised. The only improvement I see is improving acoustic isolation of the windows for traffic noise. Would recommend 100%

It's good place to stay for couple days

description:
Our apartment in the heart of Istanbul.

Istiklal Street (Istanbul's busiest street) is just a 7-minute walk away.

Taksim Square is only 15 minutes to walk away.

Galata Tower, one of the most touristic places of Istanbul, is only 15 minutes walking distance.

Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque are a 20-minute walk away.

In addition to being very close to tourist areas, it is also very close to public transportation centers.

reviews.text:
Overall, we had a nice stay and I’m generally satisfied with the experience, which is why I’m giving 4 stars.
The location is very convenient, and the host was kind, friendly, and easy to communicate with.
Just a few small notes that could make the stay even better: the apartment felt a bit more worn than in the photos, there was no kettle, the shower cabin could use some repair, and one of the power sockets was slightly loose, which made me a little concerned about safety with a small child.
In general, we enjoyed our stay, and with a few minor improvements this place could be even more comfortable for future guests.

I spent about a month as a guest at Murrat’s place, and I can’t even begin to describe how much fun it was! It was the best month of my life.
The house is located in a local area with friendly locals. The neighborhood is a great place to explore, with a rich culture. It was so much better than going to landmarks in Istanbul. We spent almost all our nights exploring the neighborhood, going alley to alley to try street food, restaurants, coffee shops, and watch kids play.
The people were incredibly friendly, and I’ve already missed the friends I made there through Google Translate. The house itself was great too. It was clean and amazing, and it felt like home to us. It also had all the equipment we needed for a long stay.
If you want to experience Istanbul and its people and culture, I highly recommend making a reservation at Murrat’s place. You won’t be disappointed!
Thanks, Murrat!

Le logement ne correspond pas du tout à la description ni aux photos de l’annonce.
Tout d’abord, la cuisine est insuffisamment équipée par rapport à ce qui était indiqué. De plus, la maison n’était pas propre à mon arrivée et dégageait une forte odeur de sanitaires et d’humidité. Cette situation m’a d’ailleurs provoqué une migraine seulement une heure après mon installation.
Par ailleurs, les murs étaient très sales, avec de nombreuses taches d’humidité qui est considéré comme poison pour la respiration ainsi que des traces de moisissure, notamment dans le coin de la cuisine. Le système de chauffage est également défaillant : il ne fonctionne que dans la chambre, ce qui rend le salon et le reste de la maison très difficiles à utiliser, surtout en cette période de froid.
Ces conditions ne sont pas acceptables et ne correspondent en aucun cas à ce qui était annoncé.

To be honest, it’s a beautiful, new house, close to all public transportation, and it has a new kitchen where we were able to cook everything. We’d like to thank Mr. Murad for his warm and respectful hospitality.

J’ai beaucoup aimer le séjour, surtout elle se trouve à quelques minutes de la grande route touristique, et galata tower qui propose beaucoup d’activités touristiques, accessible, propose beaucoup d’endroits pour une petite balade en amoureux 😍.

Internally curtain rod broken hanging in the middle big crack in wall near front door, downstairs toilet did not work we only booked accommodation knowing that there was a second toilet! Su’s little house is great
Pros are Looks exactly like the photos, A/C in both bedrooms located on the second floor, and on the first floor, where the kitchen and the half bath is located. Very comfortable beds. Great hot water and pressure. Basement has a great little living room. flexible, check-in, which we really appreciated.
Cons: and this is only my personal opinion is even though the house is located on a side street. There is a a lot of traffic that cuts through the street. So if you are a light sleeper, this is going to be an issue. If you are not this place is perfect The house is small, but it was great for the two of us. (even for four people). It still is a good space. The only other con is the half bath toilet has a mind of its own and decides when it wants to flush and when it doesn’t. Having said that I still would definitely recommend this little house. It’s in a great neighborhood with shops and restaurants within walking distance. You will love it!

The house is beautifully decorated and has a cozy atmosphere. However, we found it smaller than it appeared in the pictures, and unfortunately, the hygiene and cleaning standards did not meet our expectations, especially for Turkish standards. The lack of an aeration system in the bathroom and the toilets on the first floor caused significant humidity issues, leading to an unpleasant smell throughout the house. Despite regularly opening windows for fresh air, the house became uncomfortably cold due to the absence of sufficient radiators.
The basement is a lovely space with a big TV, but the lack of heating made it too cold to enjoy for more than an hour. We relied heavily on the AC units in the bedrooms to stay warm, but they were noisy and made sleeping uncomfortable.
Considering that we booked this home to spend quality time indoors during Christmas, the overall experience did not match the price we paid. We hope these issues can be addressed to improve the experience for future.

I stayed at Su’s place with my parents for nearly two weeks and couldn’t have asked for more. The house was fantastic – modern, well-equipped, clean, and very comfortable. Su was incredibly responsive, even to urgent requests, like when I accidentally locked the door with the key inside – she had it resolved in no time. I highly recommend both the accommodation and Su as a host. Thank you so much, Su!

Great location, and the host was extremely helpful when looking for a pharmacy open on a Sunday, even calling places to confirm. Check in and out were effortless. The place itself was exactly what we needed, clean, comfortable, and cute.

reviews.text:
We stayed at Özgür’s apartment for 10 days. The location was great—just a few minutes from Galata Tower, the metro, and lots of restaurants. The apartment is in an old building and had a noticeable smell. There's a market downstairs, but the prices were high and seemed to increase daily—especially if you don’t speak Turkish (e.g., water went from $4 to $5 in two days).
The apartment had plenty of towels and bed sheets. There was no coffee, water, or even a coffee pot—we had to buy one ourselves. No coffee machine either. The shower was great and there was always hot water. The two bedrooms had queen beds, but only one AC unit in the living room, though a fan was available. The washing machine was broken when we arrived and got fixed two days later.
Check-out was frustrating. Despite no reservation after us, we were only given until 12:00 and had to ask multiple times before the co-host kindly agreed to extend it. For the price (same as I paid in NYC), I expected better flexibility.

The place was exactly as described. It was exceptionally clean and in a perfect area. there are some great restaurants and cafe's nearby. The wifi was also okay, perfect for remote work and average usage. The apartment is in a side-street with little to no traffic and really close to Galata tower and the tram. The apartment is quite spacious, much bigger than the majority of places in Istanbul. the kitchen was completely equipped and the bathroom had shower gel and shampoo. The host was also really nice and he even let us leave our bags for a few hours after the check-out time.

Özgür was a wonderful host - friendly, responsive, and helpful throughout our stay. The apartment was clean, stylish, and exactly as described. The location was perfect, with everything we needed close by. We felt very comfortable and well taken care of. Highly recommend staying here if you're visiting the area!

Unfortunately, we had to cut our stay short after the first night due to a broken shower. While the host made an effort to fix it, we were disappointed that the issue was known but not mentioned at check-in. Additionally, the street noise and light were very disruptive, especially since the main bedroom lacked blackout curtains. Noise would have been better if one window had fully latched. The streetlight directly outside made the room extremely bright at night.
There was a general lack of attention to detail, which really detracted from our experience. Several lightbulbs were burned out, and the kitchen lighting had a harsh, unattractive tone. The building entrance was dirty and had a strong odor of cat feces, which was also noticeable in the hallway.
All of these issues are easily fixable, but the lack of attention and accountability in what is otherwise a high-demand location made this stay a poor choice for us.

Özgür was quite friendly and helpful, the location is good, there many shops and activities in the walkable areas. The house was clean just the bedrooms were a little smaller than expected. Overall, I recommend this place.
